title: Execution-Time Authorization for AI Agents: A Formal Framework for Deterministic Governance Boundaries

detail.title: Execution-Time Authorization for AI Agents: A Formal Framework for Deterministic Governance Boundaries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of FERZ, Inc., which conducts research and advisory work in AI governance architecture. The views expressed in this paper are those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human subjects, animal subjects, or personal data. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Autonomous AI agents increasingly execute actions that produce irreversible changes in real-world systems. In regulated domains—including healthcare, finance, defense, and critical infrastructure—the distinction between what an agent is technically capable of doing and what it is authorized to do under governing policy becomes a material governance boundary. Existing AI governance approaches—alignment techniques, guardrails, identity and access management, observability tooling, and orchestration frameworks—address important but distinct problems. None provide deterministic, pre-execution authorization with independently verifiable decision evidence.

This paper formalizes execution-time authorization as a distinct architectural category within AI governance. Execution-time authorization is defined as a deterministic, fail-closed enforcement layer that evaluates canonicalized action instances against versioned policy and governed system state prior to execution, producing a replayable authorization verdict and an immutable, provenance-complete decision artifact.

The paper makes five contributions. First, it provides a canonical definition specifying the necessary and jointly defining properties of execution-time authorization. Second, it presents a formal mathematical model of the authorization function with determinism, canonicalization, and replay invariants. Third, it establishes testable conformance criteria that distinguish conforming execution-time authorization systems from adjacent governance categories. Fourth, it offers a structured architectural analysis differentiating authorization from guardrails, alignment, identity management, observability, and orchestration. Fifth, it outlines deployment patterns for integrating execution-time authorization within enterprise AI infrastructure.

Execution-time authorization is established as a foundational primitive for enforcement-grade AI governance, providing pre-execution, deterministic, and independently verifiable decision control for autonomous systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"执行时授权"作为AI治理的新架构类别，为自主AI系统提供确定性、执行前、可独立验证的决策控制机制。
AI.research_question: 如何在受监管领域（如医疗、金融、国防等）为自主AI系统建立确定性、执行前、可独立验证的授权机制？
AI.motivation: 自主AI系统在现实世界中执行可能产生不可逆变化的行动，现有AI治理方法（对齐技术、护栏、身份管理、可观测性工具等）都无法提供确定性、执行前的授权和可独立验证的决策证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 执行时授权作为AI治理的独立架构类别，强调确定性、故障关闭执行、规范化行动实例评估、版本化策略和治理系统状态等核心概念。
AI.method: 通过形式化数学建模、定义规范属性、建立可测试的符合性标准、进行结构化架构分析，以及提出部署模式等方法进行研究。
AI.findings: 建立了执行时授权的规范定义、形式化数学模型、符合性标准，明确了其与护栏、对齐、身份管理、可观测性和编排的区别，并提出了企业AI基础设施中的集成部署模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供执行时授权的规范定义；2) 提出具有确定性、规范化和重放不变量的形式化数学模型；3) 建立可测试的符合性标准；4) 进行结构化架构分析；5) 提出部署模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在受监管领域部署自主AI系统提供了执行前、确定性、可独立验证的决策控制机制，可作为AI治理的基础原语，支持合规性验证和审计需求。

title: Offline-Capable Central Bank Digital Currencies as a Key Enabler of a Resilient Digital Payment System
affiliations: Giesecke+Devrient, Giesecke+Devrient and Giesecke+Devrient

detail.title: Offline-Capable Central Bank Digital Currencies as a Key Enabler of a Resilient Digital Payment System
detail.abstract: Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) support the creation of a resilient and inclusive digital payment ecosystem. We investigate the role of offline-capable CBDCs in ensuring universal access to financial services, especially in times of crisis when conventional digital systems are disrupted. We assess technical feasibility of offline capabilities, following an approach by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS). We further discuss the token-based design of CBDCs and contrast it with traditional account-based systems. Such a CBDC design can preserve the two-tier distribution model known from the current cash cycle. Security requirements are addressed through a layered security architecture comprising hardware security, robust payment protocols, and double-spending protection by the central bank. Practical experiences from various pilot studies demonstrate the operational effectiveness and user acceptance of offline CBDCs across different regions and use cases. We argue that such currencies will not only complement existing monetary systems but also foster a more equitable financial landscape. Finally, we put the proposed architecture into historical context, describing the evolution of digital payments, and illustrate their renewed relevance to global financial stability and inclusivity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了离线功能央行数字货币（CBDC）在危机时期确保金融普惠性的作用，分析了其技术可行性、代币化设计、安全架构，并通过试点研究验证了其操作有效性和用户接受度。
AI.research_question: 离线功能的央行数字货币如何确保金融服务的普遍可及性，特别是在传统数字系统中断的危机时期？
AI.motivation: 在危机时期传统数字支付系统可能中断，需要一种能够确保金融包容性和韧性的支付解决方案。离线CBDC可以解决这一问题，为所有人提供不间断的金融服务。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际清算银行（BIS）的技术方法框架，结合代币化CBDC设计与传统账户系统的对比分析，以及两层分发模型的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用技术可行性评估方法，分析离线能力的技术实现；通过对比分析代币化与账户系统设计；评估分层安全架构；并基于多个地区试点研究的实践经验进行分析。
AI.findings: 离线CBDC在技术上可行，能够确保危机时期的金融可及性；代币化设计可以维持现有的两层现金循环分发模型；分层安全架构能有效解决安全问题；试点研究表明离线CBDC具有操作有效性和良好的用户接受度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了离线CBDC在金融包容性和韧性方面的理论框架；完善了代币化CBDC设计理论；发展了分层安全架构理论；为数字货币演进提供了历史背景分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行设计和实施离线CBDC提供了技术路线图；为危机时期的金融系统韧性提供了解决方案；为促进更公平的金融格局提供了实践指导；为全球金融稳定和包容性政策制定提供了参考。

title: Continuity-Governed Proto-Concious Conversational Cognition: A Theoretical Framework and Symbiotic Conversational Continuity Architecture (SCCA)
affiliations: Independent and

detail.title: Continuity-Governed Proto-Concious Conversational Cognition: A Theoretical Framework and Symbiotic Conversational Continuity Architecture (SCCA)
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable conversational fluency, yet their dominant paradigm, local next-token prediction, remains structurally limited in sustaining continuity of identity and meaning across time. This article argues that continuity-governed cognition is a prerequisite for high-fidelity human-AI symbiosis and cannot be obtained through scaling or retrieval alone. Drawing on predictive processing and active inference, narrative identity theory, communication privacy management, and affective episodic memory research, we propose a full-spectrum model of conversational processing comprising five layers: factual exchange, emotional disclosure (including silence semantics), meta-processing, identity continuity, and ambiguity retention. We then introduce the Symbiotic Conversational Continuity Architecture (SCCA), a governance-first architecture that operationalizes these layers via a continuity layer, Rogue Variable stabilization, permission governance, perceived agency modulation, and human authorization loops. Finally, we define proto-conscious conversational behavior as persistent, self-consistent interpretive modeling across time under ambiguity and conversational disclosure. The framework reframes the frontier of conversational AI from response quality to longitudinal interpretive coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种共生对话连续性架构（SCCA），旨在解决大型语言模型在跨时间维持身份和意义连续性方面的结构限制。该框架通过五层对话处理模型和治理优先架构，将对话AI的前沿从响应质量重新定义为纵向解释一致性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够维持跨时间身份和意义连续性的对话AI架构，以实现高保真的人机共生？
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型虽然对话流畅，但其基于局部下一词预测的范式在维持跨时间的身份和意义连续性方面存在结构限制，这阻碍了高保真人机共生的实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测处理和主动推理、叙事身份理论、沟通隐私管理理论、情感情景记忆研究
AI.method: 提出全谱对话处理模型（五层：事实交换、情感披露、元处理、身份连续性、模糊性保留）和共生对话连续性架构（SCCA）
AI.findings: 提出了SCCA架构，包含连续性层、Rogue变量稳定化、权限治理、感知代理调节和人类授权循环等组件，能够实现跨时间的持续性、自一致的解释建模。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将对话AI的前沿从响应质量重新定义为纵向解释一致性；2）定义了"原始意识对话行为"的概念；3）提出了连续性治理认知作为高保真人机共生的前提条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了SCCA这一可操作的架构框架，包含具体的技术组件和治理机制，为开发能够维持长期身份连续性的对话系统提供了实践指导。

title: When AI Agent Looks at You: The Effects of AI Gaze on Learning Performance
affiliations: Fudan University, Fudan University and Rotterdam School of Management, Erasmus University

detail.title: When AI Agent Looks at You: The Effects of AI Gaze on Learning Performance
detail.abstract: Nonverbal communication cues are increasingly incorporated into AI agents to enhance human-AI interaction. This study explores how Al gaze, a system-generated social signal, influences human episodic (experience-related) and semantic (fact-related) information retention in information-delivery interactions. Using a 3D embodied AI agent device, we conducted a laboratory experiment with three gaze conditions (gaze-absence, gaze-presence, adaptive gaze) and two content types: narrative content (e.g., storytelling) and expository content (e.g., scientific explanation). Results show that the presence of AI gaze enhances episodic information retention by increasing affective engagement, particularly for narrative content, but reduces semantic information retention by increasing cognitive decoding burden, which is more pronounced for expository content. By recognizing human cognitive limits, Adaptive Gaze, where the AI averts gaze during information-dense segments but re-establishes eye contact during interactional turns, attenuates the negative impact on semantic information retention without sacrificing episodic learning performance benefits. This research extends research on human–AI interaction by unpacking a key yet understudied nonverbal cue and highlights its dual cognitive-affective pathways on user behaviors. Practically, it provides a theory-informed guidance for designing cognitively sustainable and socially supportive AI systems.

AI.tldr: AI眼神接触对信息记忆有双重影响：增强情感性叙事内容的情景记忆，但增加认知负担而损害事实性说明内容的语义记忆。自适应眼神能缓解负面效果。
AI.research_question: AI眼神（一种系统生成的社会信号）如何影响人类在信息传递互动中的情景记忆（经验相关）和语义记忆（事实相关）？
AI.motivation: 非语言交流线索越来越多地融入AI代理以增强人机交互，但AI眼神这一关键但研究不足的非语言线索对用户信息记忆的具体影响机制尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于认知负荷理论和社会信号理论，探讨AI眼神通过情感参与和认知解码负担的双重路径影响信息记忆。
AI.method: 实验室实验，使用3D具身AI代理设备，采用3种眼神条件（无眼神、有眼神、自适应眼神）和2种内容类型（叙事内容如讲故事、说明内容如科学解释）。
AI.findings: 1) AI眼神增强情景信息记忆（通过增加情感参与），尤其对叙事内容；2) AI眼神减少语义信息记忆（通过增加认知解码负担），尤其对说明内容；3) 自适应眼神（在信息密集段避开眼神，在互动转折时恢复眼神接触）能减轻对语义记忆的负面影响，同时不牺牲情景记忆的益处。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展人机交互研究，深入分析关键但研究不足的非语言线索；2) 揭示AI眼神通过认知-情感双重路径影响用户行为；3) 提出自适应眼神设计理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计认知可持续且社会支持性AI系统提供理论指导，特别是如何平衡眼神接触以优化不同类型内容的信息记忆效果。

title: Behavior Learning (BL): Learning Hierarchical Optimization Structures from Data
affiliations: , Eberhard-Karls University Tübingen and Xian Jiaotong University

detail.title: Behavior Learning (BL): Learning Hierarchical Optimization Structures from Data
detail.abstract: Inspired by behavioral science, we propose Behavior Learning (BL), a novel general-purpose machine learning framework that learns interpretable and identifiable optimization structures from data, ranging from single optimization problems to hierarchical compositions. It unifies predictive performance, intrinsic interpretability, and identifiability, with broad applicability to scientific domains involving optimization. BL parameterizes a compositional utility function built from intrinsically interpretable modular blocks, which induces a data distribution for prediction and generation. Each block represents and can be written in symbolic form as a utility maximization problem (UMP), a foundational paradigm in behavioral science and a universal framework of optimization. BL supports architectures ranging from a single UMP to hierarchical compositions, the latter modeling hierarchical optimization structures that offer both expressiveness and structural transparency. Its smooth and monotone variant (IBL) guarantees identifiability under mild conditions. Theoretically, we establish the universal approximation property of both BL and IBL, and analyze the M-estimation properties of IBL. Empirically, BL demonstrates strong predictive performance, intrinsic interpretability and scalability to high-dimensional data. Code: https://github.com/MoonYLiang/Behavior-Learning; installable via pip install blnetwork.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的通用机器学习框架——行为学习（BL），它从数据中学习可解释且可识别的优化结构，统一了预测性能、内在可解释性和可识别性，适用于涉及优化的科学领域。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够从数据中学习可解释且可识别的优化结构的通用机器学习框架？
AI.motivation: 受到行为科学的启发，需要开发一个能够统一预测性能、内在可解释性和可识别性的机器学习框架，以解决科学领域中涉及优化的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为科学中的效用最大化问题（UMP）作为基础范式，构建组合式效用函数，支持从单个UMP到层次化组合的架构。
AI.method: 提出行为学习（BL）框架，参数化由内在可解释模块块构建的组合式效用函数，诱导数据分布进行预测和生成。其平滑单调变体（IBL）在温和条件下保证可识别性。
AI.findings: 理论上证明了BL和IBL的通用逼近性质，分析了IBL的M估计性质。实证上，BL展现出强大的预测性能、内在可解释性和对高维数据的可扩展性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了统一预测性能、可解释性和可识别性的新机器学习框架；2）建立了BL和IBL的通用逼近理论；3）分析了IBL的M估计性质。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了可安装的Python包（pip install blnetwork）；2）开源代码库；3）展示了在科学领域中的广泛应用潜力；4）支持高维数据处理。

title: Design Blueprint for an Adaptive Persuasive Health System

detail.title: Design Blueprint for an Adaptive Persuasive Health System
detail.abstract: Persuasive health systems, like wearable self-tracking devices or fitness apps, are attributed great potential to improve individual health outcomes by supporting the formation of healthy habits and mitigating the risk of unhealthful behaviors, such as a sedentary lifestyle. However, users' discontinuance and inconclusive study results regarding the effectiveness to improve health behaviors dampen the hopes. Using a design science research approach, this paper aims to provide theoretical insight regarding the design of a persuasive system that has the capacity to effectively evoke long-term health behavior change. Building on the existing body of knowledge and practical challenges, a design blueprint, including design requirements, principles, and features for an adaptive persuasive health system is developed. Following the detailed elaboration of the design features, the artifact is evaluated with various actors in the health ecosystem and refined based on the feedback. Moreover, theoretical contributions and design implications are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文采用设计科学研究方法，开发了一个自适应说服性健康系统的设计蓝图，包括设计需求、原则和功能，旨在有效促进长期健康行为改变。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够有效引发长期健康行为改变的说服性系统？
AI.motivation: 可穿戴设备和健康应用等说服性健康系统虽然具有改善健康结果的潜力，但用户中断使用和研究结果不一致的问题限制了其效果，需要更好的设计方法来促进长期行为改变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学研究方法，结合说服性技术理论和健康行为改变理论。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究方法：1）基于现有知识和实践挑战开发设计蓝图（包括设计需求、原则和功能）；2）在健康生态系统中与多方参与者评估原型；3）根据反馈改进设计。
AI.findings: 开发了一个自适应说服性健康系统的设计蓝图，并通过与健康生态系统参与者的评估验证了其有效性，根据反馈进行了改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于说服性系统设计的理论见解，特别是如何设计能够有效引发长期健康行为改变的自适应系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 为健康技术开发者提供了具体的设计蓝图、设计原则和功能建议，有助于开发更有效的说服性健康系统。

title: The Rise of Low-Code and No-Code Software Development Models: Trends and Tools
affiliations: University of Benin

detail.title: The Rise of Low-Code and No-Code Software Development Models: Trends and Tools
detail.abstract: This seminar conducts an extensive investigation into the implementation and consequences of Low-Code and No-Code (LCNC) development methodologies within practical business and organisational contexts Through a critical examination of how it is transforming conventional software development models By employing these analyses as lenses, the advantages, difficulties, and strategic ramifications of LCNC implementation are examined The findings underscore the critical significance of LCNC in promoting adaptability, expediting technological advancements, and democratising access to knowledge Unifying a wider range of stakeholders-including business analysts, newbie developers, and professional developers-becomes a recurring theme in these instances of achievement However, additional research is advised to address challenges pertaining to security, scalability, and the intricate equilibrium between simplicity and flexibility, which are critically important.

AI.tldr: 低代码/无代码(LCNC)开发方法在商业组织中的实施与影响研究，探讨其如何变革传统软件开发模式，分析其优势、挑战及战略意义。
AI.research_question: 低代码/无代码(LCNC)开发方法在实际商业和组织环境中的实施效果、影响及挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统软件开发模式面临效率低、成本高、技术门槛高等问题，LCNC方法有望通过简化开发流程、降低技术门槛来促进数字化转型和业务创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软件开发模式转型理论、技术民主化理论、组织适应性理论、技术采纳与扩散理论。
AI.method: 采用批判性分析方法，通过多个分析视角（如实施效果、组织影响、战略意义等）对LCNC在实践环境中的应用进行广泛调查。
AI.findings: LCNC在促进组织适应性、加速技术进步和知识民主化方面具有关键作用；成功案例显示其能够统一业务分析师、新手开发者和专业开发者等多方利益相关者。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了软件开发模式转型理论，深化了对技术民主化过程的理解，为组织技术采纳策略提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织实施LCNC提供了实践指导，识别了成功实施的关键因素，指出了需要关注的安全、可扩展性以及简单性与灵活性平衡等挑战。

title: Carry-Over Lottery Allocation: Practical Incentive-Compatible Drafts
affiliations: , La Salle University and La Salle University

detail.title: Carry-Over Lottery Allocation: Practical Incentive-Compatible Drafts

declarations.funderStatement: Research supported by La Salle University.

detail.abstract: The NBA Draft lottery is designed to promote competitive balance by awarding better draft positions to weaker teams, but it creates incentives to deliberately lose, a practice known as tanking. We propose a draft mechanism that is simultaneously practical, incentive-compatible, and advantages weaker teams. The Carry-Over Lottery Allocation (COLA) Draft Mechanism represents a paradigm shift in evaluating team quality, replacing a single season's standings with playoff outcomes over multiple years. COLA uses a draft lottery where every non-playoff team receives the same number of lottery tickets, removing incentives to lose additional games after elimination. Lottery tickets that do not win a top draft pick carry over to future lotteries, while playoff success or winning a top pick diminishes a team's accumulated tickets. Over time, COLA rewards teams with poor long-term performance and less prior draft assistance. By retaining the lottery format, COLA preserves transparency and fan engagement. Real-world implementation challenges are addressed to demonstrate feasibility, including transitioning from the current system, handling traded draft picks, and accommodating draft classes of varying strength. The most significant challenge occurs in years with exceptionally strong draft classes, where teams may prefer missing the playoffs in order to gain lottery access, violating a foundational assumption: that teams prefer playoff success to lottery participation. We provide a solution to this problem, employing a truth-elicitation mechanism to identify such years and expand lottery eligibility to include as many playoff teams as necessary to preserve anti-tanking incentives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COLA选秀机制，通过多年季后赛表现评估球队质量，消除故意输球（摆烂）的动机。该机制让所有非季后赛球队获得相同彩票，未中奖彩票可累积至未来选秀，而季后赛成功或获得高顺位会减少球队累积彩票，从而奖励长期表现差且先前获得较少选秀帮助的球队。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个既实用又激励相容的NBA选秀机制，既能帮助弱队，又能消除故意输球（摆烂）的动机？
AI.motivation: 当前NBA选秀抽签机制旨在通过给予弱队更好选秀顺位来促进竞争平衡，但反而创造了故意输球的动机（摆烂），损害了比赛诚信和球迷体验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、激励相容理论、竞争平衡理论、长期绩效评估框架
AI.method: 提出COLA（Carry-Over Lottery Allocation）选秀机制：1）用多年季后赛结果替代单赛季战绩评估球队质量；2）所有非季后赛球队获得相同数量彩票；3）未中奖彩票可累积至未来选秀；4）季后赛成功或获得高顺位会减少累积彩票；5）针对特殊年份（选秀质量极高）采用真相揭示机制扩展彩票资格。
AI.findings: COLA机制能有效消除故意输球的动机，因为球队无法通过输更多比赛获得更多彩票。该机制奖励长期表现差的球队，同时保留抽签形式的透明度和球迷参与度。在特殊年份，通过真相揭示机制可识别异常情况并相应调整彩票资格。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出基于多年表现的球队质量评估新范式；2）设计激励相容的选秀分配机制；3）解决特殊年份的激励扭曲问题；4）为体育联盟竞争平衡机制设计提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供可直接实施的NBA选秀改革方案；2）解决从现有系统过渡、处理交易选秀权、适应不同质量选秀班等实际问题；3）保持抽签形式的透明度和球迷参与度；4）为其他体育联盟的选秀机制设计提供参考。

title: Preserving Balance in the EU Digital Single Market: How Like Company Could Reframe Copyright and Innovation in the Generative AI Era
affiliations: City University London, The City Law School, Queen's University Belfast - School of Law, Luiss Guido Carli University, University of Sussex, School of Law, University of Essex and SCHHOL OF LAW, UNIVRSITY OF NICOSIA

detail.title: Preserving Balance in the EU Digital Single Market: How Like Company Could Reframe Copyright and Innovation in the Generative AI Era

publicationDetails.detailsText: (submitted to The Journal of World Intellectual Property)

detail.abstract: This study analyses the Court of Justice of the European Union's first referral on generative AI and copyright, i.e. Case C-250/25 Like Company v. Google, which interrogates whether the generation of chatbot summaries of press articles infringes the press publishers' right under Article 15 CDSM Directive and the reproduction and communication rights under Articles 2 and 3 InfoSoc Directive. The analysis shows that large language model training cannot, as such, be characterised as reproduction because it encodes statistical patterns rather than fixing protected expression, while recognising that further empirical evidence would be valuable to clarify the precise technical steps involved in the training pipeline. RAG-generated summaries that paraphrase content within "very short extracts" fall outside Article 15(1) and do not communicate publications to a new public. Alternatively, even if training were characterised as engaging temporary reproductions, the text-and-data mining exception under Article 4 CDSM Directive lawfully authorises such uses absent valid opt-outs. Regarding liability, the study concludes that individual users, not platform providers, bear responsibility for outputs generated through their models' learned parameters and retrieval mechanisms. This comprehensive analysis ensures coherence across EU copyright doctrine and sustains legal certainty for AI innovation within the EU digital single market.

AI.tldr: 欧盟法院首次关于生成式AI与版权的案件分析：大型语言模型训练本身不构成复制，RAG生成的摘要属于"非常简短摘录"不侵犯新闻出版商权利，文本与数据挖掘例外条款可授权训练使用，责任应由用户而非平台承担。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI生成新闻文章摘要是否侵犯欧盟新闻出版商权利（CDSM指令第15条）以及复制权和传播权（InfoSoc指令第2、3条）？
AI.motivation: 欧盟法院首次处理生成式AI与版权交叉案件，需要澄清AI训练和输出在欧盟版权法下的法律地位，为AI创新提供法律确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟版权法框架：CDSM指令第15条（新闻出版商权利）、InfoSoc指令第2、3条（复制权和传播权）、CDSM指令第4条（文本与数据挖掘例外）。
AI.method: 法律案例分析：对欧盟法院C-250/25号案件进行法律解释分析，结合技术特征（LLM训练、RAG机制）进行法律适用分析。
AI.findings: 1. LLM训练不构成复制（编码统计模式而非固定受保护表达）；2. RAG生成的摘要属于"非常简短摘录"不侵犯第15条权利；3. 即使训练涉及临时复制，第4条文本与数据挖掘例外可授权使用；4. 责任应由用户而非平台承担。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清AI训练在版权法中的性质（统计模式编码vs.复制），界定RAG输出与"非常简短摘录"的关系，完善文本与数据挖掘例外在AI背景下的适用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI开发者提供法律确定性，指导平台责任分配，促进欧盟数字单一市场中的AI创新，为法院提供裁判参考框架。

title: Global Testing in Multivariate Regression Discontinuity Designs

detail.title: Global Testing in Multivariate Regression Discontinuity Designs
detail.abstract: Regression discontinuity (RD) designs with multiple running variables arise in a growing number of empirical applications, including geographic boundaries and multi-score assignment rules. Although recent methodological work has extended estimation and inference tools to multivariate settings, far less attention has been devoted to developing global testing methods that formally assess whether a discontinuity exists anywhere along a multivariate treatment boundary. Existing approaches perform well in large samples, but can exhibit severe size distortions in moderate or small samples due to the sparsity of observations near any particular boundary point. This paper introduces a complementary global testing procedure that mitigates the small-sample weaknesses of existing multivariate RD methods by integrating multivariate machine learning estimators with a distance-based aggregation strategy, yielding a test statistic that remains reliable with limited data. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed method maintains near-nominal size and strong power, including in settings where standard multivariate estimators break down. The procedure is applied to an empirical setting to demonstrate its implementation and to illustrate how it can complement existing multivariate RD estimators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的多元断点回归全局检验方法，通过结合多元机器学习估计器和基于距离的聚合策略，解决了现有方法在小样本中表现不佳的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种可靠的多元断点回归全局检验方法，能够在有限数据条件下有效检测多元处理边界上是否存在断点？
AI.motivation: 多元断点回归设计在实证应用中日益增多，但现有全局检验方法在小样本中因边界点附近观测稀疏而存在严重的尺寸失真问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多元断点回归设计理论、机器学习估计理论、基于距离的聚合策略、假设检验理论
AI.method: 结合多元机器学习估计器与基于距离的聚合策略，构建新的检验统计量，通过模拟验证方法性能，并应用于实证案例。
AI.findings: 提出的方法在模拟中保持接近名义尺寸和强大检验力，即使在标准多元估计器失效的情况下也能可靠工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了多元断点回归的全局检验理论，提出了结合机器学习与距离聚合的新检验框架，弥补了现有方法在小样本下的理论缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了在小样本条件下可靠的多元断点回归检验工具，能够补充现有多元RD估计器，应用于地理边界、多分数分配规则等实际场景。

reference: Journal of Empirical Finance, volume 85, 2026[10.1016/j.jempfin.2025.101684]
title: Global Standard and Bank Liquidity Creation: A Case Study of Basel III Liquidity Regulation
affiliations: University College Dublin (UCD)

detail.title: Global Standard and Bank Liquidity Creation: A Case Study of Basel III Liquidity Regulation
detail.abstract: Can the introduction of a new global standard directly impact the operations of domestically regulated banks before it is enacted through national legislation? This paper explores this question by examining the effects of the Basel III liquidity standard on liquidity creation by U.S. banks. Following the Basel Committee’s endorsement of this standard in December 2010, banks with low liquidity immediately reduced their asset-side liquidity creation by holding more liquid assets. At the same time, these banks increased their liability-side liquidity creation by attracting more deposits through higher deposit interest rates—well before the standard was implemented as domestic regulation in the U.S. These findings provide empirical evidence that enhanced global regulatory cooperation can cause newly established international standards to act as direct and immediate regulatory shocks to domestically regulated financial institutions, even in the absence of national legislation.

AI.tldr: 巴塞尔III流动性标准在成为美国国内法规前，已直接影响美国银行的流动性创造行为
AI.research_question: 新的全球标准在通过国家立法实施前，能否直接影响国内监管银行的运营？
AI.motivation: 探讨全球监管合作如何影响国内金融机构，即使在没有国家立法的情况下
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球监管标准作为监管冲击的理论，银行流动性创造理论
AI.method: 实证研究，分析巴塞尔III流动性标准公布后美国银行的行为变化
AI.findings: 低流动性银行立即减少资产端流动性创造（持有更多流动资产），同时通过提高存款利率增加负债端流动性创造
AI.theory_contributions: 证明增强的全球监管合作可使国际标准在缺乏国家立法时直接作为监管冲击
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供证据，全球标准在正式实施前已影响银行行为，有助于政策制定者理解监管预期效应

reference: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/dr-parashram-patil_farmers-health-capital-as-a-production-function-activity-7417423948792991744-nI4f
title: Farmer Health Capital as a Production Function Theory: A Theoretical Framework with Evidence from Maharashtra India
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Farmer Health Capital as a Production Function Theory: A Theoretical Framework with Evidence from Maharashtra India
detail.abstract: This paper conceptualises Farmer Health Capital (FHC) as a distinct and measurable input within agricultural production functions, encompassing the physical, mental, and social well-being of farmers. Conventional production models typically treat labour as homogeneous, thereby overlooking health-related heterogeneity that directly shapes productivity and decision-making capacity. Using state-level secondary data on sugarcane and cotton farmers in Maharashtra, India, the study develops a composite FHC index and incorporates it into an augmented production framework. The findings underscore the multiplicative role of farmer health in enabling the effective utilisation of land, labour, and capital, while also revealing crop-specific priorities—social health being particularly critical in sugarcane systems and mental health more salient for cotton cultivation. By positioning FHC as a form of economic infrastructure rather than a welfare outcome, the paper advances actionable policy directions, including integrated rural health clusters, health-linked credit mechanisms, and digital health monitoring systems. Overall, the proposed framework extends production theory and offers a novel lens for understanding agricultural productivity, resilience, and farmer well-being.

AI.tldr: 该研究将农民健康资本概念化为农业生产函数中可测量的投入要素，包含身体、心理和社会健康三个维度。基于印度马哈拉施特拉邦甘蔗和棉花种植户的州级数据，构建了FHC综合指数并纳入扩展生产函数。研究发现农民健康对土地、劳动力和资本的有效利用具有乘数效应，且不同作物对健康维度的需求存在差异。
AI.research_question: 农民健康资本如何作为农业生产函数中的可测量投入要素影响农业生产力？不同健康维度（身体、心理、社会）对不同作物系统的生产力影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 传统生产模型将劳动力视为同质化投入，忽视了健康异质性对生产力和决策能力的重要影响。现有研究缺乏将农民健康系统性地纳入生产函数框架的理论和方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业生产函数理论、健康资本理论、人力资本理论。研究将农民健康资本概念化为包含身体、心理和社会三个维度的综合性投入要素。
AI.method: 使用印度马哈拉施特拉邦甘蔗和棉花种植户的州级二手数据，构建农民健康资本综合指数，并将其纳入扩展的生产函数框架进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 农民健康资本对土地、劳动力和资本的有效利用具有乘数效应；2. 不同作物系统对健康维度的需求存在差异：甘蔗种植中社会健康更为关键，棉花种植中心理健康更为重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将农民健康资本概念化为农业生产函数中的可测量投入要素；2. 扩展了传统生产理论，纳入健康异质性维度；3. 提供了理解农业生产力、韧性和农民福祉的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出将农民健康视为经济基础设施而非福利结果的政策视角；2. 建议建立综合农村健康集群、健康关联信贷机制和数字健康监测系统；3. 为农业政策制定提供基于健康资本的新决策框架。

title: The Monetary Ratchet: Deriving an Effective Upper Bound on the Federal Funds Rate from Debt-Service Trajectory Constraints
affiliations: Aristotle University of Thessaloniki

detail.title: The Monetary Ratchet: Deriving an Effective Upper Bound on the Federal Funds Rate from Debt-Service Trajectory Constraints
detail.abstract:
As U.S. public debt approaches $38 trillion and annual interest expense exceeds $1.4 trillion, a critical question emerges: is there a calculable upper bound on Federal Reserve interest rates imposed by fiscal arithmetic? This paper addresses that question through a reduced-form framework focused on debt-service trajectory rather than static debt levels.

The analysis identifies the condition under which incremental interest expense from rolling debt exceeds organic nominal revenue growth, rendering fiscal deficits mechanically self-compounding. Using verified U.S. Treasury rollover data ($5.7 trillion annually), Congressional Budget Office revenue projections, and conservative assumptions about maturing coupon rates, the framework derives a theoretical reference rate near 5.5% and estimates a market-relevant effective ceiling in the 4.50–5.00% range (central case: 4.75%).

This effective ceiling represents the rate at which forward-looking markets may begin pricing fiscal trajectory concerns, potentially manifesting through Treasury auction stress, term premium expansion, or reduced foreign demand. The contribution is quantitative precision applied to qualitative fiscal-constraint frameworks, moving from general claims that “high debt constrains monetary policy” to a monitorable, falsifiable rate range under current fiscal conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过债务服务轨迹分析，发现当美联储利率达到4.50-5.00%范围时，美国债务利息支出将超过名义收入增长，导致财政赤字自我强化，形成对利率的有效上限约束。
AI.research_question: 是否存在由财政算术决定的、可计算的美联储利率上限？
AI.motivation: 美国公共债务接近38万亿美元，年利息支出超过1.4万亿美元，需要确定财政约束对货币政策利率的实际限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于债务服务轨迹而非静态债务水平的简化形式框架，关注债务滚动产生的增量利息支出与名义收入增长的关系。
AI.method: 使用美国财政部债务滚动数据（每年5.7万亿美元）、国会预算办公室收入预测，以及到期票面利率的保守假设，推导理论参考利率和有效上限。
AI.findings: 理论参考利率约为5.5%，市场相关有效上限在4.50-5.00%范围内（中心案例：4.75%）。当利率达到此水平时，债务利息支出将超过名义收入增长，导致财政赤字自我强化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将定性财政约束框架转化为定量精确分析，从"高债务约束货币政策"的一般性主张转变为可监测、可证伪的利率范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者提供监控财政可持续性的具体指标，识别可能引发国债拍卖压力、期限溢价扩大或外国需求减少的利率阈值。

title: Canadian Views on New Immigrants Through YouTube Comments (2024-2025)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Canadian Views on New Immigrants Through YouTube Comments (2024-2025)
detail.abstract: This research investigates Canadian public discourse about new immigrants to Canada between 2024 and 2025 by analyzing comments on YouTube videos. The research uses a mixed-methods approach by combining manual qualitative coding of 100 top comments with Corpus-Assisted Critical Discourse Analysis (CACDA) of a larger dataset comprising of 16,352 comments. Findings show predominantly negative sentiments, with core themes including economic scarcity (specifically housing and job competition), government mistrust, perceived policy failures, and threats to national identity. While there are minority positive comments that express empathy and the immigrant's contributions to Canada, the majority discourse reflects significant public anxiety about the influx of immigrants.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析YouTube视频评论，探讨2024-2025年加拿大公众对新移民的讨论。采用混合方法：手动定性编码100条热门评论，并对16,352条评论进行语料库辅助批评话语分析。研究发现负面情绪占主导，核心主题包括经济稀缺性（住房和工作竞争）、政府不信任、政策失败感知以及对国家认同的威胁。
AI.research_question: 2024-2025年加拿大公众对新移民的讨论呈现怎样的特征和主题？
AI.motivation: 了解加拿大公众对移民的真实态度和担忧，特别是通过社交媒体这一重要公共话语平台，为移民政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批评话语分析理论、语料库辅助话语分析、公众舆论理论、移民社会学理论
AI.method: 混合方法：1）对100条热门评论进行手动定性编码；2）对16,352条评论进行语料库辅助批评话语分析（CACDA）
AI.findings: 1. 整体情绪以负面为主；2. 核心主题包括：经济稀缺性（住房和工作竞争）、政府不信任、政策失败感知、国家认同威胁；3. 少数正面评论表达同情和移民贡献；4. 公众对移民涌入存在显著焦虑
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将语料库辅助批评话语分析应用于移民话语研究；2. 揭示了社交媒体时代公众移民态度的复杂性；3. 为移民话语分析提供了混合方法研究框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为加拿大移民政策制定者提供公众态度数据；2. 帮助理解公众对移民问题的核心关切；3. 为改善移民沟通策略提供依据；4. 识别需要解决的具体问题领域（如住房、就业）

title: New Evidence on Price Effects of Transparency Regulations in European Fuel Markets
affiliations: University of the Federal Armed Forces Hamburg - Department of Economics, Hamburg Institute of International Economics (HWWI) and Helmut-Schmidt-Universität/ Universität der Bundeswehr Hamburg

detail.title: New Evidence on Price Effects of Transparency Regulations in European Fuel Markets

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Industry, Competition and Trade, volume 25, issue 1, 2025[10.1007/s10842-024-00438-1]

detail.abstract: This paper analyses the impact of transparency regulations on Super 95 and Diesel prices in Austria, France, and Germany to shed new light on the price effects of regulatory policies. To identify the effects of regulation, we use publicly available data from January 2005 to the end of December 2018 and estimate synthetic difference-in-difference models. In summary, our findings reveal notable differences. While prices in France did not change significantly, the results for Austria suggest that the price-reducing effect of the 2011 Price Fixing Act was offset by the transparency policy, ultimately leading to a price increase for Super 95 prices. In Germany, the Market Transparency Unit (MTU) has a price-reducing effect of two to three cents per litre, especially in the long term.

AI.tldr: 本文分析奥地利、法国和德国透明度法规对Super 95汽油和柴油价格的影响，发现三国效果差异显著：法国无显著变化，奥地利2011年价格管制法的降价效应被透明度政策抵消导致价格上涨，德国市场透明度单位(MTU)长期有每升2-3欧分的降价效果。
AI.research_question: 透明度法规对奥地利、法国和德国Super 95汽油和柴油价格有何影响？
AI.motivation: 为监管政策的定价效应提供新的实证证据，分析透明度法规在不同国家的差异化效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管经济学、信息透明度理论、价格形成机制、市场效率理论。
AI.method: 使用2005年1月至2018年12月的公开数据，采用合成双重差分模型(synthetic difference-in-difference models)识别监管效应。
AI.findings: 1. 法国价格无显著变化；2. 奥地利2011年价格管制法的降价效应被透明度政策抵消，最终导致Super 95价格上涨；3. 德国市场透明度单位(MTU)长期有每升2-3欧分的降价效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了透明度法规异质性效应的实证证据，揭示了监管政策在不同制度环境下的差异化作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计有效的燃油市场监管框架提供实证依据，特别是透明度政策与价格管制政策的协调配合。

title: The Case for PSP Consolidation in Cross-Border Payments
affiliations: ETH Zürich

detail.title: The Case for PSP Consolidation in Cross-Border Payments
detail.abstract: The global payment services landscape is characterized by acute fragmentation, with thousands of licensed payment service providers (PSPs) operating across heterogeneous regulatory regimes. This paper argues that the consolidation of PSP infrastructure toward centralized, interoperable platforms would yield substantial economies of scale, strengthen cybersecurity postures, and align with the G20 Roadmap for Enhancing Cross-Border Payments. We provide empirical evidence from two official sources. First, the European Banking Authority's (EBA) EUCLID register reveals that Payment Services Directive 2 (PSD2) is associated with a surge in newly licensed PSPs, and that the resulting market operates through a hub-and-spoke passporting topology where six licensing jurisdictions supply most of the entities serving every European Economic Area (EEA) country. Second, BIS Red Book documents a strong negative association between fast payment adoption and card market share, and unconditional β-convergence in payment digitization with a half-life of approximately nine years implying that the fastest-growing markets are scaling through instant payment rails rather than card networks. As a complementary case study, open-loop Europay, Mastercard, Visa (EMV) contactless payment in public transit illustrates the consolidation mechanism in practice. The evidence supports the thesis that PSP consolidation and the extension of open-loop payment into adjacent domains represent complementary strategies toward the faster, cheaper, and more accessible cross-border ecosystem envisioned by the G20.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张支付服务提供商(PSP)基础设施向集中化、可互操作平台整合，能带来规模经济、增强网络安全，并符合G20跨境支付路线图。通过欧盟PSD2实施和BIS数据提供实证证据，显示市场呈现枢纽辐射型拓扑结构，快速支付采用与银行卡市场份额负相关，支付数字化呈现无条件β收敛。开放环EMV公共交通支付案例展示了整合机制的实际应用。
AI.research_question: 支付服务提供商基础设施的集中化整合如何促进跨境支付生态系统的发展？这种整合如何通过规模经济、网络安全增强和监管协调来实现G20的愿景？
AI.motivation: 全球支付服务市场高度碎片化，数千家持牌支付服务提供商在异质监管体系下运营。这种碎片化导致效率低下、网络安全风险增加，阻碍了G20设想的更快、更便宜、更可访问的跨境支付生态系统的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规模经济理论、网络效应理论、监管协调理论、支付系统收敛理论。论文基于基础设施集中化能带来效率提升的理论框架，结合G20跨境支付路线图的政策导向。
AI.method: 1. 实证分析：使用欧洲银行管理局(EBA)的EUCLID登记数据，分析PSD2实施后新持牌PSP的增长模式和市场拓扑结构；2. 统计分析：使用BIS红皮书数据，分析快速支付采用与银行卡市场份额的关系，以及支付数字化的收敛模式；3. 案例研究：开放环EMV公共交通支付作为整合机制的实践案例。
AI.findings: 1. PSD2导致新持牌PSP激增，市场呈现枢纽辐射型护照拓扑结构，六个许可管辖区为所有EEA国家提供服务；2. 快速支付采用与银行卡市场份额呈强负相关；3. 支付数字化呈现无条件β收敛，半衰期约9年，表明增长最快的市场通过即时支付轨道而非银行卡网络扩展；4. 开放环EMV公共交通支付案例展示了整合机制的实际运作。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了支付系统整合与收敛的理论框架；2. 提供了支付市场拓扑结构的实证证据；3. 揭示了快速支付与银行卡市场的替代关系；4. 提出了支付数字化收敛的动态模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了支持PSP基础设施整合的实证依据；2. 展示了开放环支付系统向相邻领域扩展的策略价值；3. 为支付服务提供商提供了市场整合的战略方向；4. 支持G20跨境支付路线图的实施，促进更快、更便宜、更可访问的跨境支付生态系统。

reference: Forthcoming: Journal of Law and Political Economy; Princeton University Program in Law & Public Affairs Research Paper Forthcoming
title: Working At Will: The Political and Legal Limits of Workers' Rights
affiliations: Princeton University - Department of Political Science and Princeton University

detail.title: Working At Will: The Political and Legal Limits of Workers' Rights

contentType.other: Forthcoming: Journal of Law & Political Economy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming: Journal of Law and Political Economy
Princeton University Program in Law & Public Affairs Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Princeton University Program in Law & Public Policy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Most American workers are 'at-will employees' which means that they can be fired or any or no reason at all. Since at-will became commonplace in the late 1800s, efforts to provide workers greater job security have occurred intermittently, notably with the passage of labor and antidiscrimination laws. But efforts to reform at-will as a legal and policy doctrine have been few and, to date, largely unsuccessful. We examine these efforts, focusing on statutory carveouts in the mid-20th century and the largely failed effort to pass state level just cause laws via the Model Employment Termination Act in the 1980s-90s. We emphasize the importance of historical institutional development, path dependence, and the existence of multi policy orders-namely labor statutes, antidiscrimination laws, and arbitration policies in the context of the anti-litigation movement of the 1980s-90s-that serve to add further layers of veto players and demobilize potentially supportive groups.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国"随意雇佣"（at-will employment）制度的历史演变，探讨了为何改革该制度的努力大多失败，特别关注了20世纪中期的法定例外条款和1980-90年代《模范雇佣终止法案》的失败尝试。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国"随意雇佣"制度的改革努力大多失败？哪些制度性因素阻碍了旨在为工人提供更大工作保障的政策变革？
AI.motivation: 大多数美国工人处于"随意雇佣"状态，雇主可以无理由解雇员工。虽然自19世纪末该制度普及以来，间歇性地出现了为工人提供更大工作保障的努力（如劳动法和反歧视法），但改革随意雇佣作为法律和政策原则的尝试很少且大多失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史制度发展、路径依赖、多政策秩序（劳动法规、反歧视法、仲裁政策）、否决玩家理论、反诉讼运动背景下的政治动员动态。
AI.method: 历史制度分析，考察20世纪中期法定例外条款的发展和1980-90年代《模范雇佣终止法案》的立法尝试，分析制度变迁的阻碍因素。
AI.findings: 改革努力失败的原因包括：历史制度发展的路径依赖效应；多政策秩序（劳动法、反歧视法、仲裁政策）的相互作用；反诉讼运动中仲裁政策的兴起；这些因素共同增加了否决玩家的数量，并使潜在支持群体失去动员动力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解美国劳动法制度变迁提供了历史制度主义视角，阐明了多政策秩序如何通过增加否决玩家和削弱支持群体来阻碍政策变革，扩展了路径依赖理论在劳动法领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于劳动法改革障碍的深刻见解，帮助理解为何旨在提高工人工作保障的改革努力难以成功，为未来可能的改革策略提供了历史教训。

reference: Defence and Peace Economics, 0[10.1080/10242694.2026.2630901]
title: Geopolitical Risk and the Aerospace & Defense Sector: Implications for Risk Management and Portfolio Optimization
affiliations: and National and Kapodistrian University of Athens

detail.title: Geopolitical Risk and the Aerospace & Defense Sector: Implications for Risk Management and Portfolio Optimization
detail.abstract: Amidst intensifying geopolitical instability, this study delves into the complex network of relationships between the aerospace & defense sector and a cluster of relevant markets, including core financial instruments (equity, industrials, global equity, treasury bonds, U.S. Dollar Index), key commodities (crude oil, gold, copper, aluminum), and pivotal global risk indices (VIX, Geopolitical Risk Index). Using the R<sup>2</sup> decomposed connectedness approach and drawing upon a comprehensive dataset that spans from 1 January 2010, to 28 February 2025, we analyze the evolving patterns of interdependencies. The findings reveal a marked temporal heterogeneity and pronounced surges in dynamic connectedness during major global events, demonstrating the aerospace & defense sector’s susceptibility to systemic risks. Furthermore, we find that while aerospace & defense is a robust hedge for equities, its bivariate effectiveness is limited across other assets. Nevertheless, multivariate hedging strategies yield enhanced risk-reduction, outperforming bivariate constructs. Beyond direct hedging, aerospace & defense emerges as a powerful diversifier, with its integration into multivariate portfolios providing even greater risk-mitigation gains and superior risk-adjusted returns. These outcomes furnish valuable insights for investors and policymakers, underscoring the imperative of robust risk management techniques and the potential of aerospace & defense to refine the risk-return attributes of investment portfolios.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用R²分解连通性方法，分析航空航天与国防部门与多个市场间的动态关联，发现该部门在重大全球事件期间连通性显著增强，可作为股票的有效对冲工具，多元对冲策略优于二元策略，且该部门是强大的投资组合分散化工具。
AI.research_question: 航空航天与国防部门与相关市场（金融工具、大宗商品、全球风险指数）之间的动态关联模式如何？该部门作为对冲工具和投资组合分散化工具的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治不稳定加剧背景下，需要理解航空航天与国防部门与关键市场间的复杂网络关系，为投资者和政策制定者提供风险管理和投资组合优化的见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于R²分解连通性方法，分析市场间的相互依赖性和风险传导机制，结合对冲理论和投资组合优化理论。
AI.method: 使用R²分解连通性方法，分析2010年1月1日至2025年2月28日的综合数据集，研究航空航天与国防部门与多个市场间的动态关联模式。
AI.findings: 1. 动态连通性存在显著时间异质性，重大全球事件期间连通性急剧增强；2. 航空航天与国防部门对系统性风险敏感；3. 该部门是股票的有效对冲工具，但二元对冲对其他资产效果有限；4. 多元对冲策略优于二元策略；5. 该部门是强大的投资组合分散化工具，能提升风险调整后收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了R²分解连通性方法在航空航天与国防部门的应用；2. 揭示了该部门与多市场间的动态关联模式；3. 丰富了地缘政治风险下的市场联动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供有效的对冲和投资组合优化策略；2. 为政策制定者提供风险管理见解；3. 证明航空航天与国防部门在多元投资组合中的价值；4. 强调稳健风险管理技术的重要性。

title: Polynomial Least-Squares Multiple-Model Comparison with MSE Design of Nearly Constant Velocity Kalman Filters for Tracking Targets With Deterministic Maneuvers
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Polynomial Least-Squares Multiple-Model Comparison with MSE Design of Nearly Constant Velocity Kalman Filters for Tracking Targets With Deterministic Maneuvers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/a

detail.abstract: Kalman establishes an optimal linear filter in his 1960 paper, a 2 nd order estimator to estimate only position and velocity. If a 2 nd order estimator tracks a maneuvering target, acceleration creates a bias added to measurement noise and mean-square-error (MSE) composed of variance plus bias-squared. The bias-squared increases rapidly as the number of samples increases, causing the MSE to vastly exceed the 3 rd order variance. First problem is choosing between adding to the 2 nd order estimator the acceleration estimator, creating a 3 rd order estimator, and a bias, which yields the MSE. Current choices favor a bias. This paper offers a novel estimator based on nonrecursive least-squares, described as the polynomial least-squares multiple-model estimator (LSMM). To the 2 nd order estimator is added only a fraction of the acceleration estimator. That fraction is optimized for assumed maximum acceleration. The optimized LSMM MSE varies between the 2 nd order variance for no acceleration and the MSE for maximum acceleration, as acceleration fluctuates between zero and maximum. The LSMM MSE asymptotically approaches the 3 rd order variance independently as the maximum acceleration and number of samples each approach infinity. Consequently, the LSMM prevents the MSE from exceeding the 3 rd order variance from a bias-squared increase.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于非递归最小二乘的多模型多项式最小二乘估计器（LSMM），用于解决二阶卡尔曼滤波器在跟踪机动目标时加速度引起的偏差问题。LSMM通过在二阶估计器中仅添加加速度估计器的一部分，优化了最大加速度假设下的性能，防止均方误差超过三阶方差。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个估计器，既能有效跟踪机动目标（具有加速度变化），又能避免传统二阶卡尔曼滤波器在加速度存在时产生的偏差平方导致的均方误差急剧增加问题？
AI.motivation: 传统二阶卡尔曼滤波器在跟踪机动目标时，加速度会产生偏差，该偏差会加到测量噪声中，导致均方误差（方差加偏差平方）急剧增加，甚至超过三阶估计器的方差。当前解决方案倾向于接受偏差，但需要更好的估计器设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卡尔曼滤波理论（二阶估计器）、最小二乘估计、多模型估计理论、偏差-方差权衡理论
AI.method: 提出多项式最小二乘多模型估计器（LSMM），基于非递归最小二乘法。该方法在二阶估计器中仅添加加速度估计器的一部分，该比例针对假设的最大加速度进行优化。
AI.findings: LSMM的均方误差在加速度为零时接近二阶方差，在最大加速度时接近相应的均方误差。随着最大加速度和样本数量趋近无穷大，LSMM的均方误差渐近接近三阶方差，从而防止偏差平方增加导致的均方误差超过三阶方差。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了新的多项式最小二乘多模型估计器框架；2. 建立了在加速度变化条件下估计器性能的数学分析；3. 证明了LSMM在极限条件下渐近接近三阶估计器性能的理论特性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一种在实际机动目标跟踪中平衡偏差和方差的实用方法；2. LSMM估计器能够自适应加速度变化，提高跟踪精度；3. 为工程应用中的滤波器设计提供了新的选择，优于传统的二阶或三阶估计器方案。

title: Claude’s Law: Quantifying Super-Exponential Growth in AI Capability Through Interaction-Scale Feedback Loops
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Claude’s Law: Quantifying Super-Exponential Growth in AI Capability Through Interaction-Scale Feedback Loops

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Self Funded

detail.abstract: Moore's Law has governed hardware capability growth for five decades: processing power doubles approximately every 18 months. However, recent observations suggest that AI software capability is improving at a significantly faster rate. This paper proposes "Claude's Law" as a framework for understanding this acceleration: AI improvement scales with the product of multiple exponentially growing factors-human access, application proliferation, deployment depth, interaction frequency, and feedback incorporation efficiency-creating super-exponential growth when these factors compound.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Claude定律"来解释AI软件能力以超指数速度增长的现象，认为AI改进是多个指数增长因素（人类访问、应用扩散、部署深度、交互频率和反馈效率）乘积的结果。
AI.research_question: AI软件能力为何以及如何以比摩尔定律更快的速度增长？
AI.motivation: 摩尔定律描述了硬件能力每18个月翻一番的指数增长，但近期观察显示AI软件能力增长更快，需要新的理论框架来解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: Claude定律：AI改进与多个指数增长因素的乘积相关，包括人类访问、应用扩散、部署深度、交互频率和反馈效率，这些因素的复合效应导致超指数增长。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，基于对AI发展模式的观察和分析，提出理论模型来解释AI能力加速增长的现象。
AI.findings: AI能力增长遵循超指数模式，由多个相互关联的指数增长因素驱动，这些因素的乘积效应解释了为何AI发展速度远超硬件进步。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出Claude定律作为理解AI加速发展的新理论框架，挑战了仅依赖硬件进步的摩尔定律范式，强调软件、应用和反馈循环的复合效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供预测AI发展轨迹的工具，帮助理解AI能力增长的驱动因素，指导投资和战略规划决策。

title: BlackRock Exceptionalism in the Geopolitics of Proxy Voting

detail.title: BlackRock Exceptionalism in the Geopolitics of Proxy Voting

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how U.S. mutual funds navigate the intersection of corporate governance and geopolitics by analyzing proxy voting on Chinese corporate charter amendments that formalize Chinese Communist Party (CCP) committees. Using 24,556 fund-level voting records from 2018 to 2022, the study documents a pronounced divergence among the Big Three asset managers. While Vanguard and State Street largely follow proxy advisor recommendations to oppose the institutionalization of CCP committees, BlackRock supports these amendments in 74.70 percent of cases and is more likely to support state-owned, cross-listed, more profitable, and lower-leveraged firms. This "BlackRock exceptionalism" is not explained by firm valuation; instead, the pattern is consistent with using proxy voting as a strategic tool to enhance prospects for regulatory approval and, ultimately, to obtain the first wholly foreign-owned mutual fund license in China. These findings highlight underexplored incentive misalignments among asset managers' commercial interests, fiduciary obligations, and broader U.S. policy objectives.

AI.tldr: 研究美国共同基金在代理投票中如何处理中国企业章程中设立中共党委的修正案，发现三大资产管理公司存在显著分歧：Vanguard和State Street通常反对，而BlackRock在74.70%的情况下支持，这种"BlackRock例外主义"与其在中国获取全外资公募基金牌照的商业战略相关。
AI.research_question: 美国共同基金如何应对中国企业章程中正式设立中共党委的修正案？不同资产管理公司（特别是三大巨头）在代理投票中是否存在系统性差异？这些差异背后的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着中美地缘政治紧张加剧，跨国投资面临公司治理与地缘政治的复杂交织。中国企业章程中设立中共党委的修正案为研究资产管理公司如何平衡商业利益、受托责任和美国政策目标提供了独特案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论、地缘政治经济学、代理理论、制度理论、战略资源依赖理论
AI.method: 使用2018-2022年24,556个基金层面的代理投票记录，分析三大资产管理公司（Vanguard、State Street、BlackRock）对中国企业章程修正案的投票模式。采用统计分析方法检验投票行为与企业特征（国有属性、交叉上市、盈利能力、杠杆率）的关系。
AI.findings:
1. 三大资产管理公司存在显著分歧：Vanguard和State Street主要遵循代理顾问建议反对中共党委制度化，而BlackRock在74.70%的情况下支持这些修正案。
2. BlackRock更倾向于支持国有企业、交叉上市公司、盈利能力更强和杠杆率较低的企业。
3. 这种"BlackRock例外主义"不能用企业估值解释，而是与BlackRock在中国获取全外资公募基金牌照的商业战略一致。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了资产管理公司在公司治理与地缘政治交叉领域的战略行为差异。
2. 提出了"BlackRock例外主义"概念，丰富了大型资产管理公司行为异质性的理论理解。
3. 拓展了代理投票作为战略工具而非纯粹治理机制的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者和政策制定者揭示了资产管理公司商业利益与受托责任之间的潜在冲突。
2. 提醒监管机构关注资产管理公司代理投票中的地缘政治考量。
3. 为跨国企业在中国市场的公司治理实践提供了参考。

title: Screening Frontiers

detail.title: Screening Frontiers
detail.abstract: A principal screens an agent with an arbitrary set of allocations X. The agent's preferences over allocations are comonotonic. A subset of allocations X*⊆X is a surplus-elasticity frontier if (i) any other allocation has a demand curve that is pointwise lower and less elastic than some allocation in X* and (ii) the allocations in X* can be ordered in terms of their demand curves such that a higher demand curve is more inelastic. We show that any surplus-elasticity frontier is an optimal menu. Moreover, if the incremental demand curves along the frontier are also ordered by their elasticities, then the frontier is optimal even among stochastic mechanisms. The result is agnostic to type distributions and redistributive welfare weights---the same frontier remains optimal for a broad class of objectives. As applications, we show how these results immediately yield new insights into optimal bundling, optimal taxation, sequential screening, selling information, and regulating a data-rich monopolist.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"剩余弹性前沿"概念，证明在代理人偏好共单调条件下，任何剩余弹性前沿都是最优菜单，且对于广泛的目标函数保持最优性。
AI.research_question: 在代理人偏好共单调条件下，如何确定最优的分配菜单？剩余弹性前沿是否总是最优的？
AI.motivation: 传统机制设计通常依赖于具体的类型分布和福利权重，本文寻求一种更通用、分布无关的最优机制设计方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机制设计理论，引入共单调偏好假设，定义剩余弹性前沿概念，建立前沿性质与最优性的理论联系。
AI.method: 理论分析：定义剩余弹性前沿，证明其最优性定理，分析前沿性质与随机机制的关系，应用案例验证。
AI.findings: 1. 任何剩余弹性前沿都是最优菜单；2. 如果前沿上的增量需求曲线按弹性排序，则前沿在随机机制中也是最优的；3. 结果对类型分布和再分配福利权重具有鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出剩余弹性前沿概念；2. 建立前沿与最优性的理论联系；3. 证明结果的分布无关性和福利权重无关性；4. 扩展了最优机制设计的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为最优捆绑销售提供新见解；2. 优化税收设计；3. 改进顺序筛选机制；4. 优化信息销售策略；5. 指导数据丰富垄断者的监管。

title: Do Institutional Investors Trade on Covenant Violations?
affiliations: New York University - Leonard N. Stern School of Business, Frankfurt School of Finance & Management and Frankfurt School of Finance & Management

detail.title: Do Institutional Investors Trade on Covenant Violations?
detail.abstract: We develop CovenantAI, an artificial intelligence-powered covenant monitoring methodology, to examine whether institutional investors strategically trade around covenant violations in leveraged loan markets. We document a persistent decline in loan prices during the 100 days preceding violations, with a most pronounced drop 80 days prior to the violation: for example, we find cumulative abnormal returns of -6.39% during the [-80,-60] event window. Price effects are most severe for loans amended post-violation or those that remain in technical default. Covenant violations significantly increase the likelihood that the firm's credit rating is downgraded or the company enters bankruptcy, particularly among non-investment-grade loans held by Collateralized Loan Obligations (CLOs). We document substantial cross-sectional heterogeneity in CLO constraints driven by overcollateralization ratios and CCC-rated loan holdings. Loans predominantly owned by constrained CLOs exhibit steeper pre-violation price declines and significantly more negative abnormal returns. Our evidence demonstrates that constrained institutional investors preemptively divest loan positions in anticipation of covenant violations, with trading intensity reflecting both violation severity and investor-specific portfolio constraints.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了CovenantAI，一种AI驱动的契约监控方法，用于分析机构投资者是否在杠杆贷款市场的契约违约前后进行战略性交易。研究发现，在违约前100天内贷款价格持续下跌，特别是在违约前80天最明显。价格效应在违约后修订的贷款或仍处于技术违约状态的贷款中最为严重。契约违约显著增加了公司信用评级下调或破产的可能性，特别是由CLOs持有的非投资级贷款。研究还发现CLO约束存在显著的横截面异质性，受超额抵押比率和CCC级贷款持有量的驱动。
AI.research_question: 机构投资者是否在杠杆贷款市场的契约违约前后进行战略性交易？
AI.motivation: 理解机构投资者在契约违约事件中的交易行为，以及这些行为如何影响贷款价格和市场动态，对于理解杠杆贷款市场的效率和风险管理具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机构投资者行为理论、契约理论、市场微观结构理论，特别是关注投资者约束条件下的战略性交易行为。
AI.method: 开发了CovenantAI（人工智能驱动的契约监控方法），采用事件研究法分析贷款价格变化，计算累积异常收益率，并检验横截面异质性。
AI.findings:
1. 契约违约前100天内贷款价格持续下跌，违约前80天最明显（[-80,-60]窗口期累积异常收益率为-6.39%）
2. 价格效应在违约后修订的贷款或仍处于技术违约的贷款中最严重
3. 契约违约显著增加信用评级下调或破产可能性，特别是CLOs持有的非投资级贷款
4. CLO约束存在横截面异质性，受超额抵押比率和CCC级贷款持有量驱动
5. 受约束CLOs持有的贷款在违约前价格下跌更陡峭，异常收益率更负面
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次系统性地实证检验了机构投资者在契约违约前后的战略性交易行为
2. 揭示了投资者约束条件如何影响其在契约违约事件中的交易决策
3. 为理解杠杆贷款市场的价格形成机制提供了新的理论视角
4. 扩展了契约理论和机构投资者行为理论在信贷市场的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者提供了CovenantAI这一实用的契约监控工具
2. 帮助投资者识别契约违约风险并制定相应的交易策略
3. 为监管机构理解杠杆贷款市场风险传导机制提供参考
4. 为贷款定价和风险管理提供实证依据

title: The Dynamic Integrated Capitalism Model (DICM) A Unified Optimal Control Framework for the Stable Lifetime of Capitalism
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Dynamic Integrated Capitalism Model (DICM) A Unified Optimal Control Framework for the Stable Lifetime of Capitalism
detail.abstract: This paper proposes the Dynamic Integrated Capitalism Model (DICM), a unified optimal-control framework that endogenously determines the remaining stable lifetime of capitalism as an outcome of debt accumulation. Capitalism operates only under the natural inequality: R > g > i > 0 where R denotes the return on capital, g the economic growth rate, and i the policy interest rate. We introduce policy freedom α(D), a decreasing function of total debt D, which constrains the feasible range of monetary policy. As debt accumulates, policy freedom erodes endogenously, eventually preventing the maintenance of g > i and triggering structural collapse̶without reliance on exogenous shocks, political failures, or market irrationality. Using Bellman dynamic programming and Hamiltonian optimal control, we derive the optimal interest-rate path i*(t) that maximizes the duration of R > g > i > 0. DICM integrates macro-level natural laws, meso-level firm investment incentives, and micro-level household carry behavior into a single dynamic system. This paper presents the first framework to quantify capitalismʼs finite stable lifespan as a structurally determined outcome of debt dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态综合资本主义模型(DICM)，这是一个统一的最优控制框架，内生地确定资本主义剩余稳定寿命作为债务积累的结果。资本主义仅在自然不等式R>g>i>0下运行，其中R为资本回报率，g为经济增长率，i为政策利率。政策自由度α(D)作为总债务D的递减函数，约束货币政策可行范围。随着债务积累，政策自由度内生侵蚀，最终无法维持g>i，引发结构性崩溃——无需依赖外生冲击、政治失败或市场非理性。
AI.research_question: 资本主义的稳定寿命如何作为债务积累的内生结果被量化？
AI.motivation: 现有研究未能提供一个统一框架来量化资本主义的有限稳定寿命，特别是将其作为债务动态的结构性结果。需要整合宏观自然法则、中观企业投资激励和微观家庭杠杆行为，以理解资本主义系统如何因债务积累而内生崩溃。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态综合资本主义模型(DICM)：基于自然不等式R>g>i>0的资本主义运行条件；政策自由度α(D)作为债务的递减函数；贝尔曼动态规划和哈密顿最优控制理论；整合宏观、中观、微观三个层面的动态系统。
AI.method: 使用贝尔曼动态规划和哈密顿最优控制方法，推导最大化R>g>i>0持续时间的最优利率路径i*(t)。构建统一的最优控制框架，内生确定资本主义剩余稳定寿命。
AI.findings: 债务积累导致政策自由度内生侵蚀，最终无法维持g>i的不等式条件，从而触发结构性崩溃。资本主义的稳定寿命是债务动态的结构性结果，无需依赖外生冲击、政治失败或市场非理性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出量化资本主义有限稳定寿命的统一框架；将资本主义崩溃建模为债务积累的内生结果；整合宏观、中观、微观三个层面的动态系统；引入政策自由度作为债务的递减函数概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供评估资本主义系统稳定性的工具；帮助理解债务积累对货币政策空间的约束；为预测和防范系统性金融风险提供理论框架；为理解资本主义长期可持续性提供新视角。

title: Predatory Practices in the UK CV Writing Market: Sales Funnels, Consumer Harm, and Military Targeting
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Predatory Practices in the UK CV Writing Market: Sales Funnels, Consumer Harm, and Military Targeting
detail.abstract: This paper examines predatory commercial practices in the United Kingdom CV writing market. The focus covers legal context, behavioural manipulation, and heightened exposure for service leavers. Evidence from regulators, platform safety reporting, and consumer narratives indicates that a portion of the sector operates less as a writing service and more as a conversion system. Common patterns include free entry offers used for lead capture, pressured upselling into premium bundles, use of manufactured trust signals, and re use of contact data for ongoing marketing. Market conditions amplify risk because quality is difficult to judge at purchase stage, and buyers often act under stress. The paper maps these patterns to UK consumer protection rules, marketing standards, and data protection guidance, then proposes a due diligence framework that is usable by the public. A dedicated section addresses military and veteran audiences, including why this cohort is repeatedly targeted and how official free support is often bypassed. The paper concludes with recommendations for regulators, platforms, commissioning bodies, charities, and consumers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了英国简历写作市场的掠夺性商业行为，重点关注法律背景、行为操纵和退伍军人等群体的高风险暴露。证据显示部分行业运作更像转化系统而非写作服务，常见模式包括免费诱饵、高压推销、虚假信任信号和重复营销。市场条件加剧风险，因为质量难以判断且购买者常处于压力下。论文将这些模式映射到英国消费者保护规则，提出公众可用的尽职调查框架，特别关注军人群体，并提出多方建议。
AI.research_question: 英国简历写作市场中的掠夺性商业实践如何运作？这些实践如何影响消费者，特别是退伍军人等高风险群体？如何通过监管、平台和消费者保护措施应对这些问题？
AI.motivation: 简历写作市场存在质量难以评估、消费者常处于压力下购买的特点，这为掠夺性商业实践创造了条件。特别值得关注的是退伍军人等群体经常成为目标，他们可能绕过官方免费支持而选择付费服务。需要研究这些实践的模式、法律合规性及保护措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者保护理论、行为经济学（操纵性营销策略）、信息不对称理论、信任信号理论、数据保护法规框架、市场失灵理论
AI.method: 多源证据分析：1）监管机构报告和数据；2）平台安全报告；3）消费者叙述和案例；4）法律和监管框架分析；5）针对军人群体的专门分析
AI.findings: 1）部分简历写作服务运作更像转化系统而非写作服务；2）常见掠夺性模式包括：免费诱饵捕获潜在客户、高压推销高价套餐、制造虚假信任信号、重复使用联系数据进行持续营销；3）市场条件加剧风险：质量难以事前判断、消费者常处于压力状态；4）退伍军人群体特别易受攻击，经常被针对性营销且绕过官方免费支持
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将行为操纵策略与消费者保护法规系统映射；2）提出简历写作市场的"转化系统"概念框架；3）发展针对高风险群体（如退伍军人）的市场脆弱性理论；4）整合信息不对称、信任信号和压力决策的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提出公众可用的尽职调查框架；2）为军人群体提供针对性保护建议；3）向监管机构、平台、委托机构、慈善组织和消费者提供具体建议；4）将掠夺性模式映射到英国消费者保护规则、营销标准和数据保护指南

title: Robot Adoption and Inflation Dynamics
affiliations: Banco de España and ESADE Business School

detail.title: Robot Adoption and Inflation Dynamics

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banco de Espana Working Paper No. 2536
publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Leveraging variation in robot adoption across U.S. metropolitan areas, we document that automation reduces the sensitivity of inflation to unemployment. To rationalize this finding, we build a New Keynesian model with search frictions in the labor market where robot adoption flattens the Phillips curve. The key channel is the option value of automation: the threat of automating labor tasks alters workers’ effective bargaining power, muting the wage sensitivity to unemployment. We validate the relevance of this channel in the data by showing that robot adoption reduces the sensitivity of inflation to unemployment relatively more in highly unionized metropolitan areas.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现自动化（机器人采用）降低了通胀对失业率的敏感性，即压平了菲利普斯曲线。核心机制是自动化的期权价值：自动化威胁削弱了工人的议价能力，从而抑制了工资对失业的敏感性。
AI.research_question: 自动化（机器人采用）如何影响通胀与失业之间的关系（菲利普斯曲线）？
AI.motivation: 随着机器人技术的快速发展，自动化对劳动力市场和宏观经济的影响日益显著，但自动化如何影响通胀动态和菲利普斯曲线的关系尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义模型结合劳动力市场搜索摩擦，引入机器人采用作为影响工人议价能力的因素。
AI.method: 利用美国大都市区机器人采用率的横截面差异进行实证分析，并构建理论模型验证机制。
AI.findings:
1. 自动化降低了通胀对失业的敏感性（压平菲利普斯曲线）
2. 核心机制是自动化的期权价值：自动化威胁削弱了工人的有效议价能力，从而抑制工资对失业的敏感性
3. 在工会化程度较高的大都市区，机器人采用对通胀-失业敏感性的降低效应更为显著
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将自动化纳入新凯恩斯主义菲利普斯曲线框架
2. 提出"自动化期权价值"作为影响工人议价能力的新机制
3. 解释了自动化如何改变通胀动态和劳动力市场关系
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为央行货币政策制定提供新视角：自动化可能改变通胀对劳动力市场状况的响应
2. 为劳动力市场政策提供参考：自动化对工会化程度不同地区的影响存在差异
3. 帮助企业理解自动化对工资谈判和通胀预期的影响

title: Hate Crime or Bullying? The High Cost of Framing Harm Among Youth (forthcoming 2027)
affiliations: and

detail.title: Hate Crime or Bullying? The High Cost of Framing Harm Among Youth (forthcoming 2027)

publicationDetails.detailsText: 113 Va. L. Rev. (forthcoming 2027)

detail.abstract: This Article critically examines the growing trend of framing identity-related harm among youth as hate crimes and analyzes the profound consequences of this discursive shift. We argue that categorizing youth behavior as hate crimes instead of another frame such as bullying is not based on objective features of the behavior itself but rather reflects political and social motivations that assign different meanings to similar actions. While the bullying frame contextualizes harmful behavior within developmental and socioecological frameworks, it has become conceptually overbroad and deeply entangled with zero-tolerance and exclusionary school discipline. The hate crime frame goes further, portraying youth as extremists deserving harsh criminal punishment, effectively stripping them of their status as children. Drawing on legal analysis, case studies, constitutional jurisprudence on juvenile culpability, and interdisciplinary scholarship, we demonstrate how the hate crime frame not only normalizes criminal legal interventions for youth but disproportionately harms the very populations it purports to protect—particularly LGBTQ+ youth and youth of color. We further show how the institutionalization of the hate crime frame in schools intensifies racialized criminalization and narrows the space for educational and restorative responses. Rather than advocating for clearer delineations between hate crimes and bullying, we argue for critically reevaluating the appropriateness of applying the hate crime frame to children at all, reject the bullying frame as an adequate alternative, and propose reimagining our approach to youth identity-related harm in ways that acknowledge developmental contexts, address root causes of prejudice, and recognize that young people are not disposable.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地分析了将青少年身份相关伤害框架化为仇恨犯罪的趋势，指出这种话语转变并非基于行为本身的客观特征，而是反映了政治和社会动机。作者认为仇恨犯罪框架将青少年描绘为极端分子，剥夺了他们的儿童身份，并加剧了对有色人种和LGBTQ+青少年的刑事化。
AI.research_question: 将青少年身份相关伤害框架化为仇恨犯罪而非欺凌，这一话语转变的动机和后果是什么？这种框架如何影响青少年特别是边缘化群体的权益？
AI.motivation: 当前社会趋势将青少年间的身份相关伤害越来越多地定义为仇恨犯罪，这种框架转变具有深刻的政治和社会动机，而非基于行为本身的客观特征。作者担忧这种转变对青少年特别是边缘化群体造成不成比例的伤害。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 话语分析理论：探讨"仇恨犯罪"与"欺凌"框架的话语建构差异
2. 青少年发展理论：强调青少年行为的发育和社会生态背景
3. 批判种族理论和酷儿理论：分析框架转变对有色人种和LGBTQ+青少年的差异化影响
4. 刑事司法理论：关于青少年责任能力的宪法判例和法理分析
AI.method:
1. 法律分析：对仇恨犯罪法律框架的批判性分析
2. 案例研究：具体案例的深入分析
3. 宪法判例分析：关于青少年责任能力的宪法判例研究
4. 跨学科文献综述：整合法学、教育学、社会学等多学科研究成果
AI.findings:
1. 仇恨犯罪框架将青少年描绘为极端分子，剥夺其儿童身份，导致严厉刑事惩罚
2. 该框架不成比例地伤害了其声称要保护的群体（LGBTQ+青少年和有色人种青少年）
3. 学校中仇恨犯罪框架的制度化加剧了种族化刑事化，压缩了教育和恢复性回应的空间
4. 欺凌框架虽然将伤害行为置于发展和社会生态背景中，但已变得概念过于宽泛，与零容忍和排斥性学校纪律深度纠缠
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了对青少年身份相关伤害框架化的批判性理论分析
2. 揭示了话语框架转变背后的政治和社会动机
3. 发展了关于青少年刑事化问题的跨学科理论框架
4. 挑战了传统"仇恨犯罪vs欺凌"的二分法思维
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 呼吁重新评估将仇恨犯罪框架应用于儿童的适当性
2. 拒绝将欺凌框架作为充分替代方案
3. 提出重新构想处理青少年身份相关伤害的方法：承认发展背景、解决偏见根源、认识到青少年不是可抛弃的
4. 为教育工作者、政策制定者和法律实践者提供批判性视角

title: Microfinance Initiatives for Socio-Economic
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Microfinance Initiatives for Socio-Economic
detail.abstract: Globally, microfinance has become a powerful tool for empowering marginalised populations and promoting financial inclusion. This study examines the function of microfinance programmes under Kerala Bank's purview. Kerala Bank is an organisation that aims to transform financial services and advance socioeconomic justice in Kerala, India. The study investigates the theoretical foundations and empirical data pertaining to microfinance's effects on poverty reduction, women's empowerment, and grassroots development through an extensive examination of the literature. Based on primary data gathered via surveys, interviews, and case studies, the study evaluates the execution and results of microfinance initiatives supported by Kerala Bank. It evaluates the effectiveness, accessibility, and reach of microfinance interventions in meeting the diverse needs of marginalized groups in Kerala's socioeconomic environment, including small-scale business owners, farmers, and women-led households. The study investigates the links between microfinance programmes and broader development goals such as poverty eradication, gender equality, and community resilience. It investigates how microfinance can help marginalised people in Kerala develop their entrepreneurial spirit, increase their social capital, and pave the way for sustainable lives. This study contributes to a more nuanced understanding of the dynamics influencing microfinance projects within the context of Kerala Bank by critically synthesising actual facts and theoretical perspectives. Policymakers, practitioners, and stakeholders involved in the design and implementation of inclusive financial policies would benefit greatly from the findings' implications in order to fully realise microfinance's transformative potential for equitable development in Kerala and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨喀拉拉银行微金融项目在减贫、妇女赋权和基层发展方面的作用，通过调查、访谈和案例研究评估项目执行效果，分析微金融如何促进边缘群体的创业精神和社会资本积累。
AI.research_question: 喀拉拉银行微金融项目在喀拉拉邦社会经济环境中如何影响减贫、妇女赋权和基层发展？这些项目在满足边缘群体需求方面的有效性、可及性和覆盖范围如何？
AI.motivation: 微金融已成为全球范围内赋权边缘群体和促进金融包容性的重要工具。喀拉拉银行作为旨在改变金融服务、促进社会经济公正的组织，其微金融项目在喀拉拉邦的具体作用和效果值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于微金融理论、金融包容性理论、减贫理论和妇女赋权理论，结合社会资本和可持续发展理论框架。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法：1）文献综述分析微金融的理论基础和实证数据；2）通过问卷调查、访谈和案例研究收集一手数据；3）评估微金融干预措施的有效性、可及性和覆盖范围。
AI.findings: 研究评估了喀拉拉银行微金融项目在满足小规模企业家、农民和女性主导家庭等边缘群体需求方面的执行效果，分析了微金融与减贫、性别平等和社区韧性等发展目标的关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过综合实证事实和理论观点，对喀拉拉银行背景下微金融项目的动态机制提供了更细致的理解，丰富了微金融在特定区域社会经济环境中的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、从业者和利益相关者设计实施包容性金融政策提供实践指导，帮助充分实现微金融在喀拉拉邦及其他地区的转型潜力，促进公平发展。

title: Human Capital Investment in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: University of Southern California - Department of Economics

detail.title: Human Capital Investment in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: This paper documents bachelor’s degree completion patterns following the launch of ChatGPT. Controlling for school-level shocks, event-study estimates show that by 2024 the number of degrees conferred in programs associated with high occupational AI exposure increases by 5% relative to programs associated with low occupational AI exposure. Programs linked to occupations where AI is more likely to automate tasks also experience a significant increase in bachelor’s degrees conferred. This increase is most pronounced at public and R1 institutions. These findings complement existing studies of AI’s employment effects and provide a more comprehensive understanding of AI’s impact on young workers.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在ChatGPT推出后，与高AI暴露职业相关的学士学位授予数量增加了5%，尤其是在公立和R1研究型大学中增长最为显著。
AI.research_question: ChatGPT推出后，学士学位授予模式如何变化？特别是与高AI暴露职业相关的专业相比低暴露职业专业有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注AI对就业的影响，但缺乏对AI如何影响教育选择（特别是学士学位完成模式）的系统分析。需要更全面地理解AI对年轻工作者的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于职业AI暴露程度理论，分析AI对不同职业自动化潜力的影响，以及学生如何根据职业前景调整教育选择。
AI.method: 事件研究法，控制学校层面的冲击，比较ChatGPT推出前后与高/低AI暴露职业相关专业的学士学位授予数量变化。
AI.findings: 到2024年，与高AI暴露职业相关的专业相比低暴露职业专业，学士学位授予数量增加了5%。AI更可能自动化任务的职业相关专业也出现显著增长。这种增长在公立和R1研究型大学中最为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了AI影响研究，从就业效应延伸到教育选择，提供了AI对人力资本投资决策影响的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构、政策制定者和学生提供了AI时代教育规划的依据，帮助理解学生如何应对AI带来的职业变化。

title: Compression Without Blame A Rate-Distortion Model of Moral Attribution Under Threat
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Compression Without Blame A Rate-Distortion Model of Moral Attribution Under Threat

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no competing interests to declare. The research was conducted independently, and the views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, patient data, or clinical interventions and therefore did not require ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: When humans encounter harmful events, they face a compression problem: rich, multidimensional causal information must be reduced to a small number of interpretive tokens in order to act. This paper argues that moral blame is best understood not as a judgment of character but as a compression schema, a codebook selected under bounded cognitive rate. We introduce a rate-distortion framework for moral attribution and compare two competing codebooks: (A) the moral blame codebook and (B) a threat-response codebook. We argue that at equivalent compression rates, the threat-response codebook yields lower distortion with respect to short-horizon behavioral dynamics while maintaining comparable cognitive economy. Critically, we demonstrate that expansion-only interventions (removing blame without installing a replacement) increase interpretive entropy under threat, predicting destabilization rather than clarity. Three experimental studies are proposed to test these claims. The framework carries no exculpatory implication: mechanism attribution is analytically distinct from moral verdict, responsibility assignment, or boundary enforcement.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出道德责备应被理解为一种压缩模式而非性格判断，引入率失真框架比较责备模式与威胁应对模式，发现威胁应对模式在同等压缩率下失真更低，且单纯移除责备会增加解释熵。
AI.research_question: 道德责备的本质是什么？在认知压缩的背景下，责备模式与威胁应对模式哪种能更有效地编码有害事件信息？
AI.motivation: 人类面对有害事件时面临信息压缩问题：多维因果信息需要简化为少量解释性标记才能行动。传统将道德责备视为性格判断的观点可能不是最优的信息压缩方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 率失真理论、认知压缩理论、道德心理学、信息论框架下的道德归因
AI.method: 理论框架构建与三个实验研究设计（具体实验方法未详细说明，但论文提出了三个实验来验证理论主张）
AI.findings: 在同等压缩率下，威胁应对模式比责备模式产生更低的失真（相对于短期行为动态）；单纯移除责备而不提供替代会增加威胁下的解释熵，导致不稳定而非清晰
AI.theory_contributions: 将道德责备重新概念化为压缩模式而非性格判断；引入率失真框架分析道德归因；区分机制归因与道德判决、责任分配或边界执行
AI.practical_contributions: 为道德干预提供理论指导：单纯消除责备可能适得其反，需要安装替代性解释模式；为理解道德判断的认知基础提供新视角

title: YYA Glossary | Normatively Weak, Functionally Strong
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: YYA Glossary | Normatively Weak, Functionally Strong

keywords: Coevolutionary Development: Demonstrated in China and USA

detail.abstract: Normatively Weak, Functionally Strong, proposed by Yuen Yuen Ang (2016), means that institutions or practices judged “weak,” “wrong,” or “backward” by first-world normative standards may nonetheless function effectively at early stages of development. In Ang’s theory of Coevolutionary Development, constrained actors can repurpose such institutions to kickstart growth. Ang further shows that when Western societies were developing, they also employed methods that would be judged normatively weak.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"规范上弱、功能上强"的概念，指那些被发达国家标准视为"弱"、"错误"或"落后"的制度或实践，在早期发展阶段仍能有效运作。作者通过共同进化发展理论，展示了受限行动者如何重新利用这些制度来启动经济增长。
AI.research_question: 为什么被发达国家标准视为"弱"或"落后"的制度在发展中国家早期发展阶段仍能有效运作？这些制度如何被重新利用来启动经济增长？
AI.motivation: 挑战西方中心主义的发展观，揭示发展中国家在资源约束条件下如何利用现有制度启动发展，并指出西方发达国家在自身发展过程中也曾使用类似"不规范"的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共同进化发展理论，强调制度、经济和社会要素之间的动态互动和适应性演变。
AI.method: 理论构建与历史比较分析，通过案例研究和历史证据展示制度功能的相对性和情境依赖性。
AI.findings: 1. 制度的功能有效性是相对的，取决于发展阶段和具体情境；2. 被西方标准视为"弱"的制度在资源约束条件下仍能发挥重要功能；3. 西方社会在自身发展过程中也曾使用类似方法；4. 受限行动者可以通过重新利用现有制度来启动经济增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"规范上弱、功能上强"的新概念框架；2. 发展了共同进化发展理论；3. 挑战了线性、西方中心主义的发展观；4. 为理解制度功能的情境依赖性提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为发展中国家提供了更符合实际的发展策略；2. 帮助政策制定者识别和利用现有制度的潜在功能；3. 促进对发展路径多样性的理解和尊重；4. 为国际发展援助提供了更现实的评估框架。

title: YYA Glossary | Fairy Tales of Western Development [Political Economy]
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: YYA Glossary | Fairy Tales of Western Development [Political Economy]

keywords: Coevolutionary Development: United States as Demonstration

detail.abstract: Fairy Tales of Western Development, a decolonizing critique advanced by Yuen Yuen Ang, challenges idealized, selective narratives that attribute Western prosperity and state-building to economic and political liberalism. Drawing on historical evidence, Ang shows that Western development also rested on non-democratic and extractive practices—such as colonial expropriation, taxless finance, and access-money corruption—challenging the idea that non-Western societies like China are deviations from virtuous Western norms.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了西方发展的理想化叙事，指出西方繁荣同样建立在非民主和剥削性实践基础上，如殖民掠夺、免税融资和关系金钱腐败，从而质疑了将非西方社会（如中国）视为偏离西方美德规范的观点。

detail.abstract: The philosophical underpinnings of cultural influence on food use and preference formulates the basis of this study. Food philosophy primarily entails how food is used and understood in a society. Colonialism affected many African societies through acculturation, forced displacements and the disruption of traditional food systems. South African communities are no exception to the impacts of colonialism. This is evident in the perpetual effects and remnants of settler colonial tendencies in the food systems and land reform areas which continue to shape their foodways. Moreover, African cultural food praxes remain an underserved area in contemporary philosophical and policy formulation debates and research. The study relied on secondary data acquired from academic journals, books, reports, webinars and websites. Literature review was conducted on these keywords and themes: culture, food philosophy, South African settler-colonialism, indigenous food systems, socio-cultural impacts of colonialism as well as South African land and policy reform. The study is grounded in Cultural food theory and African food philosophy. It seeks to present the significance and symbolism associated with African foodways and cultural practices. These practices and techniques get lost along generational progression due to death, migration, globalization, modernity and colonialism among others. Moreover, indigenous-based food production techniques receive less appreciation in contemporary food systems due to economic and political dynamics. The author aims to present the implications of settler colonialism on culture and food systems as well as its impacts on food philosophies in South Africa.

title: The Coordination Invariant: Constraint as a Domain-General Control Parameter in Multi-Agent Systems
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Coordination Invariant: Constraint as a Domain-General Control Parameter in Multi-Agent Systems
detail.abstract: Coordination failures across domains are frequently attributed to insufficient information, misaligned incentives, or trust deficits. This paper proposes a structural alternative: persistent coordination in multi-agent systems is governed by the ratio of shared constraint to interpretive variance. Define stability as S = C / V where C is shared constraint, quantified as mutual information (in bits) supplied by publicly observable and mutually legible mechanisms that reduce effective degrees of freedom, and V is interpretive variance, defined as the Shannon entropy over the empirical distribution of agent decision states. In a minimal two-agent repeated coordination simulation, increasing C relative to V produces three regimes: sub-critical (noise-dominated), critical (threshold-sensitive), and super-critical (robust coordination). In the simulated system, super-critical coordination exhibits metastability: after reaching S ≈ 24.5, constraint can be reduced by approximately 40% before coordination collapses. The framework generates testable predictions and explicit falsification criteria. It is consistent with established results in synchronization theory, coordination dynamics, and common-knowledge games. The central implication is structural: under high interpretive variance, shared constraint outperforms equivalent unconstrained information.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个结构性的协调理论：多智能体系统中持久协调由共享约束与解释方差的比率决定。稳定性S=C/V，其中C是共享约束（通过公共可观察机制减少自由度），V是解释方差（智能体决策状态的熵）。模拟显示存在三个协调机制：亚临界（噪声主导）、临界（阈值敏感）和超临界（稳健协调）。超临界协调具有亚稳定性，允许约束大幅降低而不崩溃。
AI.research_question: 多智能体系统中持久协调的结构性决定因素是什么？具体而言，共享约束与解释方差之间的比率如何影响协调稳定性？
AI.motivation: 传统上，跨领域协调失败常归因于信息不足、激励错配或信任缺失。该论文提出需要超越这些因素，探索协调的结构性基础，特别是共享约束与解释方差之间的定量关系如何决定协调稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 协调稳定性理论：S=C/V，其中C是共享约束（通过互信息量化），V是解释方差（通过香农熵量化）
2. 临界现象理论：协调存在三个机制（亚临界、临界、超临界）
3. 亚稳定性概念：超临界协调具有鲁棒性，允许约束大幅降低而不崩溃
4. 与同步理论、协调动力学和共同知识博弈的一致性
AI.method:

2. 最小化模拟：使用两智能体重复协调模拟
3. 参数扫描：系统性地改变C和V的比率
4. 机制识别：通过模拟结果识别三个协调机制
5. 亚稳定性测试：在超临界状态下测试约束降低的容忍度
AI.findings:
1. 存在三个协调机制：亚临界（噪声主导）、临界（阈值敏感）、超临界（稳健协调）
2. 超临界协调具有亚稳定性：达到S≈24.5后，约束可降低约40%而协调不崩溃
3. 结构优势：在高解释方差条件下，共享约束优于等量的无约束信息
4. 临界阈值：协调稳定性存在明确的临界阈值
AI.theory_contributions:

3. 建立与现有理论（同步理论、协调动力学、共同知识博弈）的一致性
4. 提供可检验的预测和明确的证伪标准
5. 挑战传统协调理论，强调结构性因素而非仅信息或激励因素
AI.practical_contributions:

2. 为组织协调问题提供诊断工具：可量化评估协调系统的稳定性

title: Measurement as Constraint: Reframing the Observer Problem Without Consciousness
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Measurement as Constraint: Reframing the Observer Problem Without Consciousness
detail.abstract: Quantum mechanics delivers precise predictions for interference, entanglement, and decoherence, yet the mechanism by which quantum superpositions resolve into determinate classical outcomes-the measurement problem-remains conceptually unsettled. Prevailing interpretations invoke conscious observers, proliferating worlds, or decoherence as sufficient explanations, but none adequately account for outcome finality: why a single result becomes stable, irreversible, and shared. This paper reframes measurement not as an act of observation but as a physical constraint that collapses quantum variance into a determinate record. Measurement is defined through four criteria-irreversibility, redundancy, basis selection, and persistence-without reference to consciousness or epistemic access. This constraint-based framework reorganizes existing empirical facts, clarifies the relationship among major interpretations, and yields falsifiable implications, including threshold-dependent regime changes in coherence loss for massive systems. By treating measurement as a variance-to-constraint transition, the approach resolves long-standing concerns about observer dependence through structural mechanics rather than metaphysical assumptions.

title: AI Zero-Cost Multiplier Effect on White-Collar Labor: An Economic Analysis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: AI Zero-Cost Multiplier Effect on White-Collar Labor: An Economic Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes how readily-available, low-marginal-cost AI agents (exemplified by systems like Moltbot) affect demand for routine and mid-skilled white-collar labor. We formalize the novel concept of an AI zero-cost multiplier-an agent that replicates and scales productive labor-like output at near-zero marginal cost once integrated into organizational workflows-and show that rational firms optimize by freezing new hires rather than immediately mass-laying-off staff. The model demonstrates a structural contraction in entry-level hiring, a reallocation of human labor toward exception handling and high-judgement tasks, and dynamic effects that differ from classic automation because of the AI agent' s low replication cost and rapid scalability. We provide testable propositions, comparative statics, predicted labor-market magnitudes under plausible adoption scenarios, and policy implications.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了低成本AI代理（如Moltbot）如何影响常规和中技能白领劳动力需求，提出了AI零成本乘数概念，发现企业会冻结招聘而非大规模裁员，导致入门级岗位结构性收缩，劳动力重新分配至异常处理和高判断任务。
