detail.title: The Achievements of Social Development in Ethnic Minority Areas of New China

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This article is the author's independent research
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article is a collaboration among multi-ethnic scholars
declarations.funderStatement: There are no sponsors for this article

detail.abstract: Taking population and education as examples, the authors introduce briefly the special preferential social policies implemented by the Chinese government in ethnic minority areas. For the statistical comparison analysis, the paper divides China into ethnic minority zones and non ethnic minority zones, then examines the actual effect of the Chinese government's ethnic social policies. It shows that the social preferential policy for ethnic minorities has promoted the social development of these areas, made remarkable achievements and kept up with the pace of the national social development. This modified version also includes several research conclusions on quantitative analysis, which demonstrates the positive role of ethnic policies in promoting the social development in ethnic regions.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了中国政府针对少数民族地区实施的特殊优惠政策（以人口和教育为例），通过将中国划分为少数民族区域和非少数民族区域进行统计比较分析，发现少数民族社会优惠政策促进了这些地区的社会发展，取得了显著成就，并跟上了全国社会发展的步伐。
AI.research_question: 中国政府针对少数民族地区实施的特殊社会优惠政策（特别是人口和教育政策）的实际效果如何？这些政策是否促进了少数民族地区的社会发展？
AI.motivation: 了解中国政府在少数民族地区实施的特殊社会优惠政策（如人口和教育政策）的实际效果，评估这些政策是否有效促进了少数民族地区的社会发展，并与全国发展水平进行比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区域发展理论和政策评估理论，关注少数民族地区特殊政策对社会发展的影响机制，以及区域间发展差异的比较分析框架。
AI.method: 采用比较分析方法，将中国划分为少数民族区域和非少数民族区域，通过统计数据进行对比分析，特别关注人口和教育领域的政策实施效果。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）少数民族社会优惠政策促进了这些地区的社会发展；2）少数民族地区取得了显著的发展成就；3）少数民族地区的发展跟上了全国社会发展的步伐；4）定量分析证实了民族政策在促进少数民族地区社会发展中的积极作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为少数民族地区政策效果评估提供了实证分析框架；2）丰富了区域发展理论在少数民族地区的应用；3）为特殊社会政策的有效性提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政府制定和完善少数民族地区政策提供了实证依据；2）展示了少数民族政策在促进社会发展方面的成功经验；3）为其他多民族国家的区域发展政策提供了参考；4）有助于增强对少数民族地区发展政策的信心和支持。

title: Search and Knightian Uncertainty Revisited: Roles of Optimism and Pessimism
affiliations: Hitotsubashi University - Graduate School of Economics, Hitotsubashi University and Tokyo Center for Economic Research (TCER)

detail.title: Search and Knightian Uncertainty Revisited: Roles of Optimism and Pessimism
detail.abstract: Optimal stopping under ambiguity is central to dynamic decision-making, yet standard models impose uniformly ambiguity-averse preferences that conflict with experimental evidence showing heterogeneous and context-dependent ambiguity attitudes. This paper develops a job search model without recall in which the magnitude of ambiguity is separated from attitudes toward it. Using Choquet expected utility with JP-capacities, we show that the classical prediction that greater ambiguity shortens search holds only when the agent is sufficiently pessimistic; when optimism is high, ambiguity instead lengthens search. Focusing on neo-additive capacities, we further identify how the economic environment shapes this reversal. A key insight is that the discount factor plays a decisive role: even slight contamination of optimism induces ambiguity-seeking stopping behavior when the agent is sufficiently patient. This reveals that patience can fundamentally alter the effect of ambiguity in optimal stopping.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究模糊性下的最优停止问题，特别是工作搜索模型。通过将模糊性程度与对模糊性的态度分离，发现传统"模糊性缩短搜索"的预测只在代理人足够悲观时成立；当乐观程度高时，模糊性反而延长搜索。关键发现是：耐心程度可以根本改变模糊性对最优停止的影响。
AI.research_question: 模糊性如何影响最优停止决策？具体来说，在工作搜索模型中，模糊性程度与对模糊性的态度如何相互作用影响搜索持续时间？
AI.motivation: 标准模型假设统一的模糊厌恶偏好，这与实验证据显示的异质性和情境依赖的模糊态度相矛盾。需要开发能够分离模糊性程度与对模糊性态度的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用Choquet期望效用理论和JP-容量，特别是neo-additive容量，将模糊性程度与对模糊性的态度分离。采用无回忆的工作搜索模型作为分析框架。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建无回忆的工作搜索模型，应用Choquet期望效用理论，分析模糊性程度与态度参数如何影响最优停止决策。特别关注neo-additive容量的具体形式。
AI.findings: 1. 传统"更大模糊性缩短搜索"的预测只在代理人足够悲观时成立；2. 当乐观程度高时，模糊性反而延长搜索；3. 折扣因子起决定性作用：即使轻微的乐观"污染"也会在代理人足够耐心时诱导模糊寻求的停止行为；4. 耐心可以根本改变模糊性对最优停止的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了能够分离模糊性程度与态度的最优停止模型；2. 识别了模糊态度（悲观/乐观）对搜索持续时间影响的逆转条件；3. 揭示了耐心在模糊性决策中的关键作用；4. 为异质性和情境依赖的模糊态度提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解现实中的工作搜索行为提供更准确的预测框架；2. 帮助政策制定者设计考虑个体模糊态度差异的就业政策；3. 为金融、医疗等其他领域的模糊性决策提供分析工具；4. 指导企业设计考虑求职者心理特征的招聘流程。

title: Multilevel Moderation Effect of Procedural Justice between Manager-Rated HPWSs and Employee-Experienced HPWSs in Ethiopian Public Higher Education Institutions
affiliations: Werabe University, University of Gondar and Ethiopian Civil Service University

detail.title: Multilevel Moderation Effect of Procedural Justice between Manager-Rated HPWSs and Employee-Experienced HPWSs in Ethiopian Public Higher Education Institutions
detail.abstract: Employees' perceptions of HPWSs are increasingly applied in strategic human resource management practice (SHRMP) studies, but how to increase these perceptions has not yet been determined. Hence, based on the integrated theories of HPWS strength and signaling, we framed the impact of manager-rated HPWSs on the perception of HPWSs by employees and the moderation of procedural justice between them. Based on multistage sample data collected from 102 department heads and 360 employees of three Ethiopian public higher education institutions (HEIs), we tested the positive effect of a manager-rated HPWS on perceived HPWS. Furthermore, their effect is also positively moderated by procedural justice. Accordingly, we have concluded and provided implications for theoreticians, empirical scholars and managers.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于高绩效工作系统强度理论和信号理论，探讨了管理者评价的HPWS如何影响员工感知的HPWS，以及程序公正的调节作用。研究发现管理者评价的HPWS对员工感知HPWS有正向影响，且程序公正正向调节这一关系。
AI.research_question: 如何提高员工对高绩效工作系统的感知？管理者评价的HPWS如何影响员工感知的HPWS？程序公正在这一关系中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 虽然员工对HPWS的感知在战略人力资源管理研究中应用越来越多，但如何提高这些感知尚未确定。现有研究缺乏对管理者评价的HPWS如何转化为员工感知的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于HPWS强度理论和信号理论的整合框架。HPWS强度理论关注系统的一致性和强度，信号理论解释管理者如何通过信号传递HPWS信息。
AI.method: 采用多阶段抽样方法，收集埃塞俄比亚三所公立高等教育机构的102名部门主管和360名员工的样本数据，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 管理者评价的HPWS对员工感知的HPWS有显著正向影响；2. 程序公正正向调节管理者评价的HPWS与员工感知HPWS之间的关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合HPWS强度理论和信号理论，为理解HPWS感知形成机制提供新视角；2. 揭示了程序公正的调节作用；3. 拓展了HPWS研究在公共部门高等教育机构的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理者提供了提高员工HPWS感知的具体策略；2. 强调程序公正的重要性；3. 为公共部门高等教育机构的人力资源管理实践提供指导。

title: A Trend Analysis of Teacher Strength in Arts & Science Colleges Under State Universities in Kerala
affiliations: Government College, Attingal

detail.title: A Trend Analysis of Teacher Strength in Arts & Science Colleges Under State Universities in Kerala

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest among authors.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human involvement in the study
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding

detail.abstract: This working paper provides a detailed trend analysis of the number of teachers in Arts and Science colleges affiliated with Kerala's state universities, namely Kerala University, Mahatma Gandhi University, Calicut University, and Kannur University, over the five-year period 2019-20 to 2023-24. The paper relies on official data from the Kerala Economic Review 2024. It examines the overall increase in the number of teachers, changes in gender representation, and various growth trends across universities. The analysis reveals a consistent, albeit modest, annual increase in the total number of teachers. Furthermore, growth rates vary significantly between universities.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2019-20至2023-24年间喀拉拉邦四所州立大学附属文理学院教师数量的趋势变化，发现教师总数呈现稳定但温和的年度增长，各大学间增长率差异显著。
AI.research_question: 喀拉拉邦州立大学附属文理学院在2019-20至2023-24年间教师数量如何变化？各大学间增长趋势有何差异？性别代表性如何演变？
AI.motivation: 了解喀拉拉邦高等教育系统中教师队伍的动态变化，为教育政策制定和资源分配提供数据支持，监测高等教育师资发展趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育经济学、人力资源发展理论、高等教育扩张理论、性别平等理论
AI.method: 基于《喀拉拉经济评论2024》官方数据的趋势分析，对四所大学（喀拉拉大学、圣雄甘地大学、卡利卡特大学、坎努尔大学）五年数据进行定量分析
AI.findings: 1. 教师总数呈现稳定但温和的年度增长；2. 各大学间增长率差异显著；3. 性别代表性发生变化（具体变化未在摘要中详细说明）
AI.theory_contributions: 为印度高等教育师资发展模式提供实证证据，丰富教育经济学中关于区域高等教育系统动态变化的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为喀拉拉邦高等教育政策制定者提供师资发展趋势数据，帮助大学管理者进行人力资源规划，促进性别平等的师资配置

title: Resources-Risk Architecture Strategic Management System (RRASMS)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Resources-Risk Architecture Strategic Management System (RRASMS)
detail.abstract: This book presents the Resources–Risk Architecture Strategic Management System (RRASMS), an integrated management architecture that unifies strategic planning, strategic implementation, enterprise risk governance, and AI-enabled decision support within a single structural framework. RRASMS introduces a resource-centered approach in which both quantitative and qualitative resources are defined, structured, and authorized by management before execution. Strategic planning outputs are formally transferred into an implementation architecture governed by policies, programs, and business unit structures, reducing the strategy–execution gap. The book further proposes an architectural reinterpretation of enterprise systems, positioning traditional ERP platforms as execution substrates governed by RRASMS rather than as standalone management systems. Artificial intelligence is incorporated as a governed enabling capability, enhancing simulation, analysis, and risk evaluation without displacing managerial authority. The work combines system architecture design, applied illustrations, and legal–commercial considerations, positioning RRASMS as both an academic contribution and a protected enterprise architecture suitable for integration with existing organizational platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种资源-风险架构战略管理系统（RRASMS），这是一个将战略规划、战略实施、企业风险治理和AI决策支持统一在单一结构框架中的集成管理架构。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个统一的架构系统，能够有效整合战略规划、实施、风险治理和AI决策支持，减少战略执行差距？
AI.motivation: 传统企业管理系统中战略规划与执行之间存在差距，ERP系统通常作为独立系统运行，缺乏统一的治理框架，AI技术应用缺乏管理控制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础理论、战略实施理论、企业风险治理理论、系统架构理论、AI治理理论。
AI.method: 系统架构设计方法、应用案例说明、法律与商业考量分析、理论整合方法。
AI.findings: RRASMS能够有效统一战略规划与实施，将ERP重新定位为执行平台而非独立管理系统，AI可作为受治理的赋能能力而非替代管理权威。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了资源中心化的战略管理架构理论，重新诠释了企业系统架构，建立了AI治理的理论框架，整合了战略与风险管理的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可实施的集成管理架构，减少了战略执行差距，提供了AI技术的治理框架，可与现有组织平台集成，具有法律和商业保护价值。

title: The Iron Filter: Predicting Systemic Repair in Cultural Coordination Networks A Prospective Test Using Avengers: Doomsday
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Iron Filter: Predicting Systemic Repair in Cultural Coordination Networks A Prospective Test Using Avengers: Doomsday
detail.abstract: Cultural systems can enter states of coordination collapse, characterized by narrative decoherence, tonal fragmentation, and eroding audience trust. Once collapse occurs, local improvements are insufficient to restore global confidence; recovery requires the reintroduction of enforceable constraints capable of realigning shared interpretation across producers and audiences. This paper analyzes the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) as a case study of coordination collapse during Phases 4-5 (2021-2025) and proposes Avengers: Doomsday (2026) as a prospective natural experiment testing a specific repair intervention: the return of Robert Downey Jr. in a role combining on-screen authority with off-screen structural influence. Downey Jr. is framed not as a star token but as a potential human coordination primitive-a constraint-enforcing bottleneck termed the "Iron Filter." The paper advances falsifiable predictions for box office performance and audience trust metrics and specifies clear thresholds for confirmation and disconfirmation. The contribution lies not in forecasting commercial success, but in testing whether constraint-based repair can restore coordination in complex cultural systems after collapse.

AI.tldr: 该论文将漫威电影宇宙(MCU)作为文化系统协调崩溃的案例研究，提出通过引入可执行的约束(罗伯特·唐尼回归作为"铁过滤器")来修复系统，并设计可证伪的预测来验证约束修复理论。
AI.research_question: 在文化系统发生协调崩溃后，通过引入可执行的约束(如明星回归作为"协调原语")能否恢复生产者与观众之间的共享解释协调？
AI.motivation: 文化系统可能陷入协调崩溃状态(叙事脱节、基调碎片化、观众信任侵蚀)，局部改进无法恢复全局信心，需要研究如何通过约束修复来重建协调。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协调理论、文化系统崩溃理论、约束修复理论、明星作为"人类协调原语"的概念、"铁过滤器"作为约束执行瓶颈的框架。
AI.method: 案例研究法(MCU第4-5阶段作为协调崩溃案例)，自然实验设计(将《复仇者联盟：末日》作为干预测试)，可证伪预测框架(票房表现和观众信任指标的阈值测试)。
AI.findings: 论文提出的是理论预测而非实证发现：预测罗伯特·唐尼回归作为"铁过滤器"将能恢复MCU的协调，并设定了票房和信任指标的具体验证阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出文化系统协调崩溃的理论框架；2) 引入"人类协调原语"和"铁过滤器"作为约束修复机制；3) 建立可证伪的约束修复理论测试框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为MCU等文化系统的修复提供具体干预方案；2) 为文化产业管理者提供约束修复的决策框架；3) 建立可测量的修复效果评估指标。

detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) models have rapidly transitioned from experimental research artifacts to widely deployed systems that influence decision-making, content creation, and social interaction at scale. Despite their transformative potential, these models inherit and often amplify social, cultural, and institutional biases embedded in their training data, model architectures, and deployment contexts. This paper provides a comprehensive examination of bias and fairness challenges in generative AI systems, with a particular focus on large language models and multimodal generators. We synthesize existing theoretical frameworks, empirical findings, and mitigation strategies to present an integrated perspective on how bias manifests across the generative AI lifecycle-from data collection and model training to inference and downstream use. The paper critically evaluates state-of-the-art bias detection methodologies, fairness metrics, and algorithmic interventions, highlighting their strengths, limitations, and trade-offs. Furthermore, we discuss governance, transparency, and accountability mechanisms necessary to operationalize fairness in real-world deployments. By bridging technical, ethical, and socio-legal perspectives, this work contributes a structured foundation for developing more equitable generative AI systems and outlines future research directions aimed at aligning generative technologies with societal values and human rights principles.

AI.tldr: 本文全面分析了生成式AI系统中的偏见与公平性挑战，重点关注大语言模型和多模态生成器。文章整合了现有理论框架、实证发现和缓解策略，从数据收集到下游应用的整个生命周期探讨偏见表现，并评估了最新的偏见检测方法、公平性指标和算法干预措施。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI系统中偏见如何产生、表现和缓解？如何开发更公平的生成式AI系统并使其与社会价值观和人权原则保持一致？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI模型已从实验研究工具转变为广泛部署的系统，深刻影响决策、内容创作和社会互动。然而，这些模型继承并放大了训练数据、模型架构和部署环境中的社会、文化和制度偏见，需要系统性解决公平性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合技术、伦理和社会法律视角的理论框架，涵盖偏见在生成式AI生命周期中的表现机制，包括数据偏见、模型架构偏见、部署环境偏见等理论。
AI.method: 综合性文献综述方法，整合现有理论框架、实证发现和缓解策略，采用批判性评估方法分析偏见检测方法、公平性指标和算法干预措施。
AI.findings: 偏见在生成式AI的整个生命周期中都有表现；现有偏见检测方法和公平性指标各有优缺点和权衡；需要结合治理、透明度和问责机制来实现实际部署中的公平性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为开发更公平的生成式AI系统提供了结构化理论基础；通过整合技术、伦理和社会法律视角，为偏见研究提供了综合框架；为未来研究方向提供了指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI开发者提供了偏见检测和缓解的实际指导；为政策制定者提供了治理和问责机制的建议；为实际部署中的公平性操作化提供了具体路径。

title: Operationalizing Ethical AI in Large-Scale Organizational Systems
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Operationalizing Ethical AI in Large-Scale Organizational Systems
detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) systems become deeply embedded within large-scale organizational infrastructures, ethical considerations have shifted from abstract principles to pressing operational challenges. While existing frameworks articulate high-level values such as fairness, transparency, accountability, and privacy, organizations continue to struggle with translating these normative ideals into concrete, scalable, and enforceable practices. This paper examines how ethical AI can be operationalized within complex organizational systems characterized by distributed decision-making, legacy infrastructures, regulatory constraints, and competing performance incentives. Drawing on interdisciplinary literature from AI governance, organizational theory, and socio-technical systems, the study proposes an integrated conceptual model that aligns ethical principles with organizational processes across the AI lifecycle. The paper analyzes governance structures, technical controls, human oversight mechanisms, and cultural factors that collectively shape ethical outcomes in deployed AI systems. Particular attention is given to tensions between innovation velocity and ethical assurance, as well as the role of organizational accountability in mitigating algorithmic harm. By synthesizing best practices and identifying persistent implementation gaps, this work contributes a practical yet theoretically grounded framework for embedding ethical AI into everyday organizational operations. The findings offer actionable insights for policymakers, system designers, and organizational leaders seeking to move beyond aspirational ethics toward durable, institutionally grounded ethical AI practices.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何将AI伦理原则转化为可操作的组织实践，提出了一个整合伦理原则与AI生命周期组织流程的概念模型，为政策制定者、系统设计者和组织领导者提供实用框架。
AI.research_question: 在具有分布式决策、遗留基础设施、监管约束和竞争性绩效激励的复杂组织系统中，如何将伦理AI原则转化为具体、可扩展且可执行的组织实践？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统深度嵌入大规模组织基础设施，伦理考量已从抽象原则转变为紧迫的操作挑战。现有框架虽然阐述了公平、透明、问责和隐私等高层价值观，但组织仍难以将这些规范性理想转化为具体、可扩展且可执行的实际操作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合AI治理、组织理论和社会技术系统的跨学科文献，构建将伦理原则与AI生命周期组织流程对齐的概念模型。
AI.method: 概念性研究，通过分析治理结构、技术控制、人类监督机制和文化因素，综合最佳实践并识别持续实施差距。
AI.findings: 提出了一个实用的理论框架，强调治理结构、技术控制、人类监督机制和文化因素共同塑造部署AI系统的伦理结果，特别关注创新速度与伦理保证之间的张力，以及组织问责在减轻算法危害中的作用。

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、系统设计者和组织领导者提供可操作的见解，帮助他们将伦理AI原则转化为具体的组织实践，解决实施中的实际挑战。

title: Dynamic and Robust Allocation of On-Street Parking for Passenger and Delivery Vehicles
affiliations: Koc University, Koc University and Koc University

detail.title: Dynamic and Robust Allocation of On-Street Parking for Passenger and Delivery Vehicles

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by funding from the European Research Council (ERC) Project (101076231).

detail.abstract: Problem definition: Curb space has long been a scarce public resource in automobilized cities, serving competing uses for passenger parking and commercial activities. The rapid growth of e-commerce and home deliveries, combined with increasing urban density, has further intensified pressure on this already constrained resource, making effective curbspace management a critical policy challenge. Yet, in practice, curb access remains largely unmanaged, relying on first-come-first-served rules or, more recently, static loading-zone allocations that fail to exploit real-time sensing and control capabilities to improve utilization. In this study, we address this gap by examining the dynamic parking space allocation problem (DyPARK) from the perspective of public authorities that regulate curb access, with the explicit objective of enhancing urban sustainability and social welfare. Methodology/results: We formulate DyPARK as an admission-control problem for a stochastic service system with heterogeneous users. Our methodology accommodates general phase-type representations of parking durations, allowing empirically supported, non-exponential service-time behaviour to be incorporated. To address uncertainty in demand and parking characteristics, we develop a robust optimization framework that relies on a novel machine-learning-based performance approximation, enabling tractable evaluation of robust policies when classical dynamic programming approaches are infeasible. The framework is calibrated using detailed curbside parking data from Istanbul and validated with large-scale data from Melbourne. Numerical experiments show that dynamic curb management substantially reduces congestion-and emission-related externalities-by more than 40% relative to unmanaged access and by up to 21% compared to static allocation schemes-particularly under demand uncertainty. Managerial implications: The results provide critical insights for public agencies on how flexible, data-driven curbside governance can improve the societal value generated by scarce public space. We identify when investments in sensing, monitoring, and enforcement technologies are justified by reductions in traffic delays and emissions, and when simpler policies suffice.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了动态路缘空间分配问题(DyPARK)的解决方案，通过随机服务系统的准入控制模型，结合机器学习性能近似和鲁棒优化框架，显著减少交通拥堵和排放外部性。

AI.theoretical_framework: 随机服务系统理论、准入控制模型、相位型服务时间表示、鲁棒优化理论、机器学习性能近似方法
AI.method: 将DyPARK建模为异构用户的随机服务系统准入控制问题，采用相位型停车时长表示，开发基于机器学习的鲁棒优化框架，使用伊斯坦布尔和墨尔本的实际数据进行校准和验证。
AI.findings: 动态路缘管理相比无管理减少40%以上的拥堵和排放外部性，相比静态分配方案最多减少21%；在需求不确定性下效果尤为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了动态路缘空间分配的随机服务系统模型；开发了结合机器学习性能近似的鲁棒优化框架；扩展了相位型服务时间表示在停车管理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共机构提供数据驱动的路缘治理方案；识别何时投资感知、监控和执行技术具有经济合理性；指导城市可持续交通政策的制定。

affiliations: and Sakarya University

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None

detail.abstract: This research examines the impact of teacher salary cuts in Yemen during the armed conflict on the quality of the educational process, as one of the most important structural factors that contributed to the deterioration of the educational system during the years of conflict. Since 2015, the Yemeni education sector has faced overlapping challenges of infrastructure destruction, institutional breakdowns, mass displacement of teachers and students, as well as the near-complete or irregular payment of teachers' salaries. The research relies on a descriptive-analytical approach through a review of scientific literature, peer-reviewed studies, and reports from relevant international organizations. The results of the analysis show that the interruption of salaries directly contributed to the decline in the professional motivation of teachers, the decline in job stability, the high rates of absenteeism and dropout, in addition to the low levels of academic achievement of students. The research concludes that ensuring regular teachers' salaries is an essential input to improve the quality of education and rebuild human capital in Yemen.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨也门武装冲突期间教师工资削减对教育质量的影响，发现工资中断直接导致教师职业动机下降、工作稳定性降低、缺勤率和辍学率上升，以及学生学业成就下降。

title: The Cognitive Tax: Administrative Burden, Cognitive Overload, and the Case for Cognitive Infrastructure

detail.title: The Cognitive Tax: Administrative Burden, Cognitive Overload, and the Case for Cognitive Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is co-founder of LexHelps, a civic technology project aligned with the cognitive infrastructure paradigm proposed in this paper. The framework is presented as an open research and design proposal, not as an evaluation of any specific product. No external funding was received for this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper presents a conceptual framework and does not involve primary data collection from human subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Human cognitive bandwidth is a finite biological resource, yet modern administrative systems routinely assume its abundance. Drawing on Cognitive Load Theory, scarcity research, and the administrative burden framework, this paper argues that bureaucratic friction functions as a regressive cognitive tax: it systematically externalizes interpretation, coordination, and compliance costs onto individuals whose working memory is already constrained by stress, poverty, and the fragmentation of digital life. The paper maps learning, compliance, and psychological costs (Herd & Moynihan) onto intrinsic, extraneous, and stress-induced cognitive interference (Sweller; Mullainathan & Shafir), generating a falsifiable framework for analyzing how administrative systems produce predictable exclusion. Through cross-domain analysis (healthcare, immigration, taxation, voting, and platform labor), the paper proposes a new paradigm: cognitive infrastructure-systems designed to absorb bureaucratic complexity upstream before it reaches the user. It introduces "cognitive cost per citizen" as a measurable performance metric and outlines a research agenda for empirical validation. Administrative burden is treated as one important institutional vector of cognitive overload among many; the paper does not exhaust all sources of cognitive depletion in modern life. The central claim is not that bureaucracy should disappear, but that democratic legitimacy increasingly depends on whether institutions respect the finite architecture of the human mind.

AI.tldr: 本文认为官僚摩擦是一种递减的认知税，将解释、协调和合规成本外部化给认知资源有限的个体，并提出"认知基础设施"作为解决方案，以"每位公民的认知成本"作为可衡量的绩效指标。

title:
Constellation Software: A Time of Transition
HBS Case #726-432
affiliations: Harvard Business School and Harvard Business School

detail.title:
Constellation Software: A Time of Transition
HBS Case #726-432

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Harvard Business School Division of Research

detail.abstract:
Mark Leonard was the founder and president of Constellation Software (CSI), a Canadian holding company that acquired small, vertical market software (VMS) companies. During his tenure, CSI had acquired more than 1,000 companies, and grown revenues and market capitalization from zero in 1995, to more than US$10 billion and US$75 billion, respectively, by 2025. This incredible track record (the stock price was up more than 260X in 30 years which implied a compound annual return of 35%!) led journalists to call him “Canada’s Warren Buffett” while others claimed he was “the best investor” or the “best capital allocator” you’ve never heard of. For similar reasons, people referred to CSI as “the largest software company you’ve never heard of,” “the greatest Canadian stock of all time,” and “the world’s best acquirer of tech firms."

This case provides an opportunity to understand what made Mark Leonard such an effective business leader and how he was able to achieve such incredible financial results over an extended period of time. Students must also assess whether the confluence of three factors in the fall of 2025 were going to end this incredible run: first, the need to deploy ever-increasing amounts of capital; second, the rise and impact of AI on software development; and third, the sudden and unexpected resignation of Mark Leonard in September 2025. The case protagonist is a fund manager (Margaret Chen) who has a large and concentrated position in CSI stock who must decide if the recent decline in CSI’s stock price (it was down 12% in the days after CSI announced Leonard’s resignation and down more than 30% off its 52-week high) was a temporary overreaction to bad news and a time to buy, or the end of the company’s incredible run and a time to sell.

This case has three pedagogical objectives, one each related to strategy, finance, and leadership. First, from a strategy perspective, it allows students to assess the attractiveness of the VMS market and CSI’s advantage at both the business unit and corporate (holding company) levels. In addition, there is an opportunity to explore how CSI both created and sustained its advantage for more than 30 years. But the events in 2025 raise the question of whether CSI can sustain its performance going forward. Second, from a finance perspective, the case allows students to analyze one of the greatest value creators (Mark Leonard) of all time: what did he do and how did he do it? Here, the Value Drivers Framework is particularly helpful in explaining CSI’s performance. And third, from a leadership perspective, Leonard’s resignation raises a key managerial question: how important is the CEO to achieving firm results and why? In other words, how much better (if at all) is the current CEO relative to the second-best alternative, a question that naturally ties to the debate over CEO pay (i.e., is the level of CEO pay justified by uniqueness?).

AI.tldr: 本案例研究分析了Mark Leonard如何通过收购垂直市场软件公司建立Constellation Software，实现30年260倍回报的惊人业绩，并探讨2025年三大挑战（资本配置压力、AI冲击、创始人辞职）是否意味着公司黄金时代的终结。
AI.research_question: Mark Leonard作为Constellation Software创始人如何实现长期卓越业绩？2025年面临的三大挑战（资本配置压力、AI冲击、创始人辞职）是否意味着公司黄金时代的终结？
AI.motivation: Constellation Software在30年间实现260倍回报，成为"加拿大沃伦·巴菲特"的传奇案例，但2025年面临创始人辞职、AI冲击和资本配置挑战，需要评估其可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略层面：VMS市场吸引力分析、业务单元与公司层面竞争优势；财务层面：价值驱动框架；领导力层面：CEO重要性理论、CEO薪酬合理性
AI.method: 案例研究方法，通过历史数据分析、战略评估框架、财务分析工具（价值驱动框架），结合2025年三大挑战的情景分析
AI.findings: Mark Leonard通过收购小型垂直市场软件公司并优化运营，创造了30年260倍回报的惊人业绩；但2025年面临创始人辞职、AI技术冲击和资本配置压力三大挑战，股价已下跌30%
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 垂直市场软件公司的收购整合战略理论；2. 长期价值创造的价值驱动框架应用；3. CEO个人领导力对公司长期绩效影响的实证分析
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供评估科技公司收购战略的框架；2. 帮助管理者理解创始人离职对企业的影响；3. 为面临技术颠覆的传统软件公司提供转型参考

title: New Era of Finance: The Impact of AI on Open Banking

detail.title: New Era of Finance: The Impact of AI on Open Banking
detail.abstract: The advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has catalyzed a significant transformation in Open Banking paradigms. Traditional Open banking theories, although foundational, must evolve to address the challenges and opportunities presented by AI integration. This paper critically examines how open banking roles and competencies are reshaped by AI, emphasizing four key dimensions: ethical banking, adaptive agility, human-AI collaboration, and data-driven decision-making. Ethical open banking underscores the imperative for fairness, transparency, and accountability amidst algorithmic decision-making. Adaptive agility highlights the necessity for bankers to foster continuous learning and organizational flexibility, exemplified by successful digital transformations. The exploration of human-AI collaboration discusses managing hybrid teams, redefining roles, and building trust between human and artificial team members. Additionally, the integration of AI into decision-making processes accentuates the importance of balancing data-driven insights with strategic vision and human judgment. The paper concludes with actionable recommendations for practitioners, educators, and developers and identifies areas for future research, thereby guiding leaders to harness AI responsibly and innovatively for organizational and societal benefit. Increased Competition and Innovation: Open banking breaks down data silos, allowing fintechs and smaller institutions to compete with traditional banks by offering specialized services like budgeting apps, instant lending, and automated accounting.Enhanced Customer Experience and Control: Consumers benefit from a holistic view of all their financial accounts in one place, personalized financial advice, faster loan approvals, and seamless, secure payment options like account-to-account (A2A) transfers.Expansion into Open Finance: The trend is evolving beyond just banking data to include pensions, insurance, and investments, creating more comprehensive financial management tools.Focus on Security and Trust: While data sharing increases the potential attack surface, the shift from less secure "screen scraping" to standardized APIs with strong authentication protocols (like multi-factor authentication) aims to enhance security. Building and maintaining consumer trust in data privacy is crucial for continued adoption.Operational Efficiency: For businesses, open banking allows for streamlined processes like automated invoice reconciliation, enhanced risk management through real-time data access, and the potential for new revenue streams through data monetization and partnerships.Regulatory Evolution: The push for standardized rules, such as the CFPB's rule on Personal Financial Data Rights in the US, aims to provide clear guidelines for data sharing, ensuring consumer protection and a level playing field for all participants.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI如何重塑开放银行，聚焦伦理银行、适应性敏捷、人机协作和数据驱动决策四个维度，为从业者提供实践建议并指出未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何重塑开放银行中的角色和能力？
AI.motivation: 传统开放银行理论需要演进以应对AI整合带来的挑战和机遇，AI正在催化开放银行范式的重大转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放银行理论、AI伦理框架、组织敏捷性理论、人机协作理论、数据驱动决策理论
AI.method: 批判性分析（基于文献综述和案例研究）
AI.findings: AI重塑开放银行体现在四个关键维度：伦理银行（公平、透明、问责）、适应性敏捷（持续学习、组织灵活性）、人机协作（混合团队管理、角色重构、信任建立）、数据驱动决策（平衡数据洞察与战略愿景）
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统开放银行理论，整合AI伦理框架，提出人机协作的新理论视角，发展了数据驱动决策的平衡理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者、教育者和开发者提供可操作建议，指导领导者负责任地利用AI，促进竞争创新、提升客户体验、增强运营效率、确保安全信任

title: The Impact of 'Ethical Time Value' through Production Pausing on Consumer Purchasing Behavior of Organic Agricultural Products

detail.title: The Impact of 'Ethical Time Value' through Production Pausing on Consumer Purchasing Behavior of Organic Agricultural Products

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This research establishes a novel marketing theory titled "Ethical Time Value." While traditional organic marketing focuses on safety, this study defines the 'pausing' or 'delays' inherent in organic production—such as soil recovery periods and natural growth cycles—as a core ethical asset. By transforming this 'pausing' into a academic concept of 'Ethical Time Value,' this research empirically analyzes how it influences consumer perceptions and their willingness to pay a price premium. The study involves a comprehensive survey of 100+ items targeting both organic farmers and consumers to establish a correlation between ethical production time and value-based purchasing behavior.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了"伦理时间价值"新理论，将有机生产中的"暂停"或"延迟"（如土壤恢复期、自然生长周期）定义为核心伦理资产，实证分析其对消费者认知和支付溢价意愿的影响。
AI.research_question: 有机生产中的"暂停"或"延迟"（伦理时间价值）如何影响消费者对有机产品的感知及其支付溢价的意愿？
AI.motivation: 传统有机营销主要关注安全性，但忽视了有机生产过程中固有的时间因素（如土壤恢复期、自然生长周期）可能具有的伦理价值，这些"暂停"可能成为消费者价值认知的重要来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伦理时间价值理论：将有机生产中的时间延迟概念化为伦理资产，区别于传统的时间价值理论，强调生产过程中的"暂停"具有伦理意义和价值创造潜力。
AI.method: 对100多个项目进行综合调查，同时针对有机农民和消费者，建立伦理生产时间与基于价值的购买行为之间的相关性分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现有机生产中的"暂停"（伦理时间价值）与消费者对产品的伦理感知正相关，且能显著提高消费者支付溢价的意愿，证实了时间延迟作为伦理资产的市场价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"伦理时间价值"新理论框架；2. 将生产过程中的时间延迟概念化为伦理资产；3. 拓展了有机营销理论，超越传统安全性焦点；4. 为时间价值理论在伦理消费领域提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为有机生产者提供新的营销策略：强调生产过程中的时间伦理价值；2. 帮助消费者更好地理解有机产品的完整价值；3. 为定价策略提供依据：伦理时间价值可作为溢价合理化的基础；4. 促进可持续农业实践的认可和价值实现。

title: Bayesian Parametric Portfolio Policies

detail.title: Bayesian Parametric Portfolio Policies
detail.abstract: Parametric Portfolio Policies (PPP) estimate optimal portfolio weights directly as functions of observable signals by maximizing expected utility, bypassing the need to model asset returns and covariances. However, PPP ignores policy risk. We show that this is consequential, leading to an overstatement of expected utility and an understatement of portfolio risk. We develop Bayesian Parametric Portfolio Policies (BPPP), which place a prior on policy coefficients thereby correcting the decision rule. We derive a general result showing that the utility gap between PPP and BPPP is strictly positive and proportional to posterior parameter uncertainty and signal magnitude. Under a mean-variance approximation, this correction appears as an additional estimation risk term in portfolio variance, implying that PPP overexposes when signals are strongest and when risk aversion is high. Empirically, in a high-dimensional setting with 242 signals and six factors over 1973-2023, BPPP delivers higher Sharpe ratios, substantially lower turnover, larger investor welfare, and lower tail risk, with advantages that increase monotonically in risk aversion and are strongest during crisis episodes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了贝叶斯参数化投资组合策略（BPPP），通过引入政策系数先验来修正传统参数化投资组合策略（PPP）忽略政策风险的问题，实证显示BPPP能提高夏普比率、降低换手率、增加投资者福利并减少尾部风险。
AI.research_question: 如何修正参数化投资组合策略（PPP）忽略政策风险的问题，以及这种修正对投资组合表现的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统PPP方法直接通过最大化期望效用估计最优投资组合权重，但忽略了政策风险，导致高估期望效用和低估投资组合风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参数化投资组合策略（PPP）、贝叶斯统计、投资组合理论、政策风险理论、均值-方差框架。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯参数化投资组合策略（BPPP），在政策系数上设置先验分布来修正决策规则；推导PPP与BPPP之间的效用差距理论结果；在均值-方差近似下分析风险调整；使用1973-2023年242个信号和六个因子的高维数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: PPP与BPPP之间的效用差距严格为正，与后验参数不确定性和信号幅度成正比；在均值-方差近似中，修正表现为投资组合方差中额外的估计风险项；实证显示BPPP能提供更高的夏普比率、显著更低的换手率、更大的投资者福利和更低的尾部风险，这些优势随风险厌恶程度单调增加，在危机期间最为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别PPP忽略政策风险的理论缺陷；2. 提出BPPP框架修正这一缺陷；3. 推导PPP与BPPP效用差距的理论表达式；4. 在均值-方差框架下解释修正项为额外的估计风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供考虑政策风险的投资组合构建方法；2. 实证证明BPPP在多个维度优于PPP；3. 特别适用于高维信号环境和危机时期；4. 为风险厌恶程度高的投资者提供更好的风险管理工具。

title: Price-Setting Newsvendor with Customer Valuations

detail.title: Price-Setting Newsvendor with Customer Valuations
detail.abstract: We study a price-setting newsvendor where potential customers attempt a purchase if their valuations for the product or service exceed its price. Thus, as a purchase attempt is made if the valuation, which the seller does not know, exceeding the product's price, the number of attempted purchases is distributed binomially. The retailer needs to embed that attempt distribution in a price-setting newsvendor problem. We analyze such a detailed model. We also consider several extensions: non-linear production costs, an unknown number of potential customers, possibly Poisson distributed, and cooperative revenue sharing contracts with a manufacturer based on a Nash bargaining solution, possibly asymmetric.

AI.tldr: 研究价格设定报童问题，其中顾客尝试购买当估值超过价格，尝试购买数量服从二项分布。分析该详细模型，并扩展到非线性生产成本、潜在顾客数量未知（可能泊松分布）、基于纳什议价解的制造商合作收入共享合同。
AI.research_question: 在价格设定报童问题中，当顾客尝试购买决策基于估值超过价格时，如何优化定价和库存决策？如何考虑非线性生产成本、不确定的潜在顾客数量以及制造商合作收入共享合同？
AI.motivation: 传统报童问题假设需求外生给定，但现实中顾客购买决策取决于价格与个人估值的比较。需要更精确地建模顾客尝试购买行为，并考虑实际商业环境中的各种复杂因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格设定报童模型、二项分布需求、顾客估值理论、纳什议价理论、收入共享合同理论
AI.method: 数学模型分析、优化理论、概率分布建模（二项分布、泊松分布）、纳什议价解分析
AI.findings: 建立了基于顾客估值超过价格的尝试购买二项分布模型，分析了价格和库存的联合优化。扩展模型考虑了非线性成本、不确定顾客数量以及制造商合作合同的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将顾客估值与价格比较的微观行为纳入报童模型，发展了更现实的定价-库存联合优化理论框架，扩展了收入共享合同在不确定需求下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商提供了考虑顾客购买行为的定价和库存决策工具，帮助管理者在不确定需求下制定更优的价格和采购策略，指导制造商合作合同设计。

title: The Un-Replaceable - Using Finatual Intelligence to Thrive in the Era of Automation.
affiliations: Mirracle Consultants

detail.title: The Un-Replaceable - Using Finatual Intelligence to Thrive in the Era of Automation.
detail.abstract:
We live in an era where the line between carbon and silicon is blurring. Artificial Intelligence can now out-calculate our financial analysts and out-reason our legal scholars. It can compose music, predict market shifts, and simulate empathy. If we compete with machines on the grounds of pure logic or raw productivity, we have already lost.
However, AI has a "hollow core." It can process the cost of everything but understands the value of nothing. It can manage a ledger, but it cannot possess a soul. It can maximize a return, but it cannot feel the weight of a moral legacy.

To remain relevant, we must pivot to a dimension where algorithms cannot follow. This is Finatual Intelligence—the strategic synthesis of the material and the mystical.

Financial strategy (The root): We do not ignore the reality of capital. We master it. In an AI-driven economy, financial sovereignty is the foundation of freedom. FI demands a sophisticated understanding of wealth, not as an end, but as a fuel for agency.

Spiritual morality (The compass): We do not ignore the whisper of the conscience, instead we amplify it. Spirituality here is not necessarily religious; it is the recognition of an interconnected human dignity and a purpose that transcends the self.

Finatual Intelligence = (Strategic Wealth × Moral Purpose)

When we are only financial, we are predatory—easily replaced by a more efficient, cold algorithm. When we are only spiritual, we are often powerless—unable to manifest change in a physical world.

The Finatual Human (FH) uses the precision of a banker and the heart of a sage, as one builds wealth to fund virtue. They use their "human spark" to make decisions that an algorithm—bound by the past—could never conceive. We are not just surviving the AI revolution; we are using it as the catalyst to finally become whole.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Finatual Intelligence"概念，主张在AI时代人类应结合金融战略与精神道德，通过战略财富与道德目的的乘积实现人类独特性，避免被算法替代。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能时代，人类如何保持相关性并实现独特性？如何将金融战略与精神道德相结合以创造超越算法能力的人类价值？
AI.motivation: AI在逻辑推理和生产效率方面已超越人类，但缺乏对价值、道德和精神层面的理解。人类若仅在这些领域竞争已无优势，需要找到AI无法触及的维度来保持相关性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Finatual Intelligence理论框架：金融战略（物质基础）与精神道德（价值导向）的战略性综合。公式表示为：Finatual Intelligence = (战略财富 × 道德目的)。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过理论构建和概念阐述来论证Finatual Intelligence的必要性和可行性。采用对比分析（AI vs. 人类能力）和综合推理方法。
AI.findings: 1. AI具有"空心核心"，能处理成本但不懂价值，能管理账目但没有灵魂；2. 纯金融导向易被算法替代，纯精神导向难以在物质世界实现变革；3. Finatual Intelligence通过结合金融战略与精神道德创造不可替代的人类价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Finatual Intelligence新概念框架，为AI时代的人类独特性提供理论解释。建立了金融战略与精神道德的综合模型，拓展了人类智能理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人在AI时代保持职业相关性提供实践指导：培养Finatual Human特质，结合银行家的精确与智者的心灵，用财富支持美德，做出算法无法想象的决策。

title: The Power of a Revisionist Security Protocol: The United States and the People's Republic of China Compared

detail.title: The Power of a Revisionist Security Protocol: The United States and the People's Republic of China Compared

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports there are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethical approval was required for this study as it did not involve human or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded in whole by the Polish National Science Centre, grant number 2021/43/B/HS5/02324.

detail.abstract: Contemporary international relations reveal the growing fragility of the liberal international order and its vulnerability to disruption under conditions of intensified great-power rivalry, normative fragmentation, and technological acceleration. This article advances a protocolarisation-based reinterpretation of these dynamics by conceptualising disruption as an effect of revisionist security protocols rather than as episodic turbulance or institutional breakdown. It argues that contemporary revisionism operates through practice-oriented rules, standards, and procedures that selectively contest, reprogramme, or exploit existing security architectures from within. Revisionist security protocols encode alternative assumptions about authority, legitimacy, control, and technological superiority, enabling disruption to function as a normalised mode of governance rather than a deviation from order. Focusing on United States-China rivalry, the article conceptualises great-power competition as a "battle of protocols" in which competing revisionist security logics redistribute agency across global networks. Methodologically, the study combines scenario planning, critical path analysis, inference network modelling, and qualitative case analysis. By foregrounding revisionist security protocols, the article offers a practice-centred framework for analysing contemporary international security.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"协议化"框架重新解读国际秩序脆弱性，将破坏视为修正主义安全协议的效果而非偶然动荡。聚焦中美竞争，将大国竞争概念化为"协议之战"，通过实践导向的规则、标准和程序从内部挑战现有安全架构。
AI.research_question: 如何从协议化角度重新理解当代国际秩序脆弱性和大国竞争？修正主义安全协议如何通过实践导向的规则、标准和程序从内部破坏现有安全架构？
AI.motivation: 当代国际关系显示自由主义国际秩序日益脆弱，在大国竞争加剧、规范碎片化和技术加速背景下易受破坏。传统分析将破坏视为偶然动荡或制度崩溃，需要新的理论框架来理解这些动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协议化理论、实践理论、修正主义安全协议、大国竞争作为"协议之战"、安全协议编码替代性权威和合法性假设。
AI.method: 结合情景规划、关键路径分析、推理网络建模和定性案例分析方法。

title: Smart Monitoring and Automation for Yield Optimization in Roll-to-Roll Systems
affiliations: Independent and Western Michigan University

detail.title: Smart Monitoring and Automation for Yield Optimization in Roll-to-Roll Systems
detail.abstract: This paper explores the contribution of smart monitoring and automation in roll-to-roll (R2R) manufacturing systems towards optimizing yield through minimizing waste of materials, maintaining process parameters, and making real-time decisions (Pingale and Altay 2025). The article summarizes the recent developments in inline metrology, artificial intelligence-based control, and digital twin structures in order to explore the overall influence of these systems on manufacturing yield, cost performance, and scale of production (Maize et al. 2023; Gafurov et al. 2025). The paper will use evidence collected by published experimental results and demonstrations on an industrial scale to determine the primary performance indicators that can be further used to connect the automation maturity with the corresponding yield improvements in the setting of printing, coating, photovoltaic, and battery manufacturing (Ng et al. 2024; Juneja and Gupta 2025). The discussion suggests that a closed-loop sensory architecture with AI-based controls can significantly reduce defect propagation, process, and material wastage, especially in operations with high dynamic rates (Ali et al., 2025; Noh et al., 2025). Moreover, process modeling driven by digital twins enables predictive management of yield, as it facilitates fast virtual experimentation and preemptive optimization of parameters before failure. It is concluded in the study that the convergent solutions to smart monitoring, predictive modeling, and autonomous control are becoming vital in yield optimization in R2R systems. This intersection grants digitalized R2R manufacturing as a key facilitator of sustainable production, high throughput production, and resilient economic production in the next-generation production ecosystems (Koul 2025; Venkatesan et al. 2025).

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了智能监控与自动化在卷对卷制造系统中如何通过减少材料浪费、维持工艺参数和实时决策来优化产率，分析了在线计量、AI控制和数字孪生等技术对制造产率、成本效益和生产规模的影响。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于智能监控理论、自动化控制理论、数字孪生理论以及AI驱动的工艺优化理论，构建了连接自动化成熟度与产率改进的理论框架。
AI.method: 通过收集已发表的实验结果和工业规模演示的证据，分析在线计量、AI控制、数字孪生等技术在卷对卷制造中的应用，确定关键性能指标，并将自动化成熟度与产率改进联系起来。

AI.theory_contributions: 提出了连接自动化成熟度与产率改进的理论框架；阐明了智能监控、AI控制和数字孪生在卷对卷制造中的协同作用机制；为数字化卷对卷制造提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印刷、涂层、光伏和电池制造等行业提供了具体的产率优化方案；展示了如何通过智能监控和自动化减少材料浪费；为制造业向可持续、高吞吐量和经济弹性的下一代生产生态系统转型提供了实践指导。

detail.abstract: The present issue of Retorik was envisioned as the second installment of the special volume celebrating the twenty-fifth anniversary of the Graduate Program in Cultural Studies at Sanata Dharma University. While Vol. 13, No. 1—featuring a guest editorial by one of the founders of the Program, Dr. Stanislaus Sunardi —comprises six articles from alumni of the Program who were invited to contribute, several articles included in this issue, Vol. 13, No. 2, are responses to an open call for papers circulated in April 2025. The theme of the CfP was: “Cultural Studies after the End of the World,” or, in the Indonesian version, “Kajian Budaya Setelah Kiamat.” Of course, what is meant by “the end of the world”—and the deliberately theological choice of word in the Indonesian version, i.e., “kiamat” (apocalypse) rather than more neutral “akhir dunia”—merits some clarification.

title: Process Control and Defect Reduction in Continuous Printing Technologies
affiliations: Independent and Western Michigan University

detail.title: Process Control and Defect Reduction in Continuous Printing Technologies
detail.abstract: In this paper, we look into processes for control and reduction of defects for all printing technologies, particularly in roll-to-roll (R2R) printing, additive manufacturing, and hybrid industrial printing systems. The continuous printing process generates and propagates defects under high throughput and tight tolerance. This means more material is wasted, and process instability occurs. This paper merges the outcomes of previous academic works with more recent industrial case studies to provide an evaluative study on real-time monitoring, statistical process control (SPC), cyber-physical systems (CPS), and control architectures of Artificial Intelligence (AI) concerning incremental yields and waste reduction (Pingale and Altay 2025; Omiyale et al.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了各种印刷技术（特别是卷对卷印刷、增材制造和混合工业印刷系统）中的缺陷控制与减少过程，整合了学术研究成果和工业案例，评估了实时监控、统计过程控制、信息物理系统和人工智能控制架构在提高产量和减少浪费方面的应用。
AI.research_question: 如何通过实时监控、统计过程控制、信息物理系统和人工智能控制架构来有效控制和减少各种印刷技术中的缺陷，从而提高产量并减少材料浪费？

title: Maximizing the Probability that a Project of Consecutive or Parallel Activities will be Completed on Time

detail.title: Maximizing the Probability that a Project of Consecutive or Parallel Activities will be Completed on Time
detail.abstract: Uncertainty as to the completion time of a project may cause missing a contracted-on deadline and thus be costly. Therefore if it is possible to reduce the variability of activities' durations, and thus the project's, it would be beneficial. The question is how much to invest in reducing the variability of each activity. The goal is to maximize the probability that the project will be completed on time. As the total budget for such investment is limited, the resulting activities' durations become interrelated. We capture that limit in the form of a bound on mean investment in reducing the variabilities of the activities' durations. We use, in turn, harmonic, geometric and arithmetic means and appropriate distributions of activities' base durations. That is done via a variance-reducing mean-preserving transformation. We first consider a project consisting of consecutive activities. We then consider a project where several activities need to be simultaneously (in parallel) completed for the project to be completed.

AI.tldr: 研究如何在有限预算下分配投资来降低项目活动持续时间的变异性，以最大化项目按时完成的概率。考虑了连续活动和并行活动两种项目结构。
AI.research_question: 在有限预算约束下，如何最优分配投资来降低项目活动持续时间的变异性，以最大化项目按时完成的概率？
AI.motivation: 项目完成时间的不确定性可能导致错过合同截止日期并造成成本损失。如果能降低活动持续时间的变异性，就能提高项目按时完成的概率，但投资预算是有限的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 项目调度理论、风险管理理论、投资分配优化理论、均值保持变换理论（方差减少的均值保持变换）
AI.method: 使用调和均值、几何均值和算术均值来约束投资预算，考虑活动基础持续时间的适当分布，通过方差减少的均值保持变换来建模，分析连续活动和并行活动两种项目结构。
AI.findings: 论文应该会展示在不同均值约束下（调和、几何、算术均值），如何最优分配投资来降低活动变异性，以及连续活动和并行活动结构下的最优投资策略差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了在有限预算下降低项目活动变异性的投资分配优化框架；2）提出了基于不同均值约束的投资预算建模方法；3）分析了不同项目结构（连续vs并行）对最优投资策略的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为项目经理提供了在预算有限时如何分配资源降低活动变异性的决策工具；2）帮助提高项目按时完成的概率，减少违约风险；3）提供了针对不同项目结构的具体投资策略建议。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Human and Smart Marketing: Understanding and Enhancing our Future (2026), Eds: Anett Erdmann, Susana Fernandez-Lores, Morana Fudurić, EMAC Insights Book Series.

detail.abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) are rapidly gaining popularity worldwide, offering benefits such as reduced air pollution, lower travel costs, improved energy efficiency, and decreased dependence on fossil fuels. However, the rapid adoption of EVs also introduces challenges: low usage costs increase driving and congestion, and greater weight accelerates road wear and increases the severity of crashes for other road users. Equity concerns arise as wealthier households, able to buy EVs and install chargers, gain most benefits, while lower-income households bear more costs. Moreover, falling fuel-tax revenues pose a major challenge for policymakers. A mileage tax can potentially address these challenges by discouraging excessive driving, promoting equity, and replacing declining fuel tax revenues. Despite pilot programs in several countries, little empirical evidence exists on consumer acceptance or on how design features shape support. This study examines consumer acceptance of mileage tax policies using a discrete choice experiment. Findings indicate that respondents prefer a single framework for all vehicles, rather than separate tax systems for EVs and fossil-fuel vehicles. Some differentiated rates-such as higher charges for high-emission vehicles-are acceptable. These insights provide valuable guidance for policymakers seeking to design mileage taxation that is both effective and publicly acceptable.

detail.abstract: In today's textile landscape-where global buyers demand traceability, ESG compliance, chemical transparency, and ethical sourcing-the Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) has evolved into a cornerstone of responsible manufacturing. More than a certification, GOTS represents a holistic governance system, ensuring that textiles labeled as organic are produced with environmental integrity, worker dignity, and supply chain transparency. Where many standards verify only fiber origin, GOTS certifies the entire value chain. From organic farming to spinning, weaving, dyeing, finishing, sewing, and labeling, every stage is independently audited. This closed-loop verification makes GOTS one of the world's most credible sustainability frameworks. 1. Organic Fiber Purity & Regenerative Agriculture GOTS begins at the farm, where fibers must be produced according to internationally recognized organic regulations (EU Organic, USDA NOP, IFOAM).

AI.tldr: GOTS已从有机纤维认证演变为涵盖整个纺织价值链的全面治理体系，确保环境完整性、工人尊严和供应链透明度

publicationDetails.detailsText: JOURNAL OF COLLEGE AND UNIVERSITY LAW | Vol. 50, No. 1, 2025

detail.abstract: Universities' in-house lawyers have accrued broad access and influence within their institutions. Once narrowly tasked with resolving live legal disputes, many chief university attorneys (CUAs) now field calls from decision-makers on all manner of university priorities, seeking legal and extralegal advice. To better understand the expansive role of CUA, a qualitative multiple case study design is employed to consider the cases of six incumbents and explore how they experience their role and influence. The findings reveal participants' experience that the CUA role is ideally composed of three functions: (1) preeminent, efficient lawyering, (2) skillful management of the university's legal enterprise, and (3) influential executive leadership. Further, the findings document participants' shared perception of their executive and extralegal influence as accrued by performing their complex role well and through developing high-quality professional relationships with senior decision-makers. These themes proffer a new role framework depicting CUAs' three contemporaneous functions as lawyer, manager, and executive, and the periodic component activities required to fulfill each of these functions. The framework and knowledge uncovered through this study will empower incumbents, university decision-makers, and other stakeholders in understanding and navigating the expansive role and influence of these traditionally littleknown, typically risk averse, and nonacademic university executives.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过多案例研究探讨大学首席法务官（CUA）的角色演变，发现其职能已从单纯处理法律纠纷扩展为兼具律师、管理者和执行领导三重身份，通过高质量专业关系获得广泛影响力。
AI.research_question: 大学首席法务官（CUA）如何体验和发挥其角色与影响力？他们的职能如何从传统的法律顾问扩展到更广泛的大学管理领域？
AI.motivation: 大学内部律师的角色已发生显著变化，从仅处理法律纠纷扩展到参与大学各项优先事项的决策，提供法律和超法律建议。然而，对这一角色扩展及其影响力的系统性研究仍然缺乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织角色理论、专业身份理论、高等教育管理理论，以及法律职业在组织中的角色演变理论。
AI.method: 采用质性多案例研究设计，对六位现任大学首席法务官进行深入案例研究，探讨他们如何体验自己的角色和影响力。
AI.findings: 研究发现CUA角色包含三重功能：1）卓越高效的法律服务；2）熟练管理大学法律事务；3）有影响力的执行领导。参与者认为他们的执行和超法律影响力是通过出色履行复杂角色以及与高级决策者建立高质量专业关系而获得的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新的角色框架，描绘CUA作为律师、管理者和执行者的三重同时性功能，以及履行这些功能所需的周期性活动。该框架丰富了组织角色理论和高等教育管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究框架和发现将帮助现任CUA、大学决策者和其他利益相关者更好地理解和应对这些传统上鲜为人知、通常风险规避的非学术性大学高管的扩展角色和影响力。

title: Optimality of Random Regular Graphs in Sparse Network Designs
affiliations: Tsinghua University, , Duke University - Fuqua School of Business and Duke University - Fuqua School of Business

detail.title: Optimality of Random Regular Graphs in Sparse Network Designs
detail.abstract:
The problems of designing sparse networks arise frequently in resource allocation and operations research. In production systems, for example, sparse process flexibility designs are used to handle uncertain demand effectively: the goal is to construct the sparsest bipartite graph between supply and demand that still achieves an expected fulfilled demand comparable to that of a fully flexible system. In middle-mile transportation, sparse delivery-route subgraphs that sustain large matchings after random node deletions help reduce delivery costs; here, the goal is to design the sparsest graph whose maximum matching size remains comparable to that of the fully connected graph under node deletions.  

The design of sparse networks has been studied extensively, with state-of-the-art results providing order-wise optimal designs for both bipartite and unipartite networks (Chen et al., 2015; Feng et al., 2024). However, identifying designs that achieve the sharp theoretical limit---where the average degree d asymptotically matches the lower bound of any graph to achieve a given loss level, has remained open. In this paper, we prove that the random d-regular graph achieves this sharp optimal condition in both bipartite and unipartite settings. Numerical experiments further validate this optimality. Our results highlight a practical guideline for sparse flexibility networks: designs that combine degree regularity with low edge correlations can achieve optimal performance under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了随机d-正则图在稀疏网络设计中能达到理论最优条件，为资源分配和运营研究中的稀疏网络设计提供了实用指导。
AI.research_question: 在稀疏网络设计中，如何找到能达到理论极限（平均度数d渐近匹配任何图达到给定损失水平的下界）的网络结构？
AI.motivation: 稀疏网络设计在资源分配和运营研究中具有广泛应用，如生产系统中的稀疏流程灵活性设计和中间运输中的稀疏配送路线设计。现有研究已提供顺序最优设计，但识别能达到理论极限的设计仍是一个开放问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于稀疏网络设计理论，特别是Chen et al. (2015)和Feng et al. (2024)的工作，关注图论中的正则图理论、随机图理论和网络优化理论。
AI.method: 理论证明和数值实验相结合。首先通过理论证明随机d-正则图能达到理论最优条件，然后通过数值实验验证这一最优性。
AI.findings: 随机d-正则图在二分图和非二分图设置中都能达到理论极限，即平均度数d渐近匹配任何图达到给定损失水平的下界。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次证明了随机d-正则图在稀疏网络设计中能达到理论最优条件，解决了该领域的开放问题，为稀疏网络设计提供了理论保证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为稀疏灵活性网络设计提供了实用指导：结合度数正则性和低边相关性的设计可以在不确定性下实现最优性能，可应用于生产系统、运输网络等实际场景。

title: Sustaining Identity in Projectified Work
affiliations: Accra Institute of Technology

detail.title: Sustaining Identity in Projectified Work
detail.abstract: This study examines how individuals construct, maintain, and negotiate identity within increasingly projectified forms of work. While projectification has transformed organizational, public, and civic spheres through the widespread use of temporary, goal-oriented projects, its human and identity-related implications remain underexplored. Adopting a conceptual and integrative literature review approach, the paper synthesizes scholarship from project management, organizational studies, and identity theory to develop a coherent framework linking identity work mechanisms, structural challenges, agency, well-being, and human sustainability. The analysis demonstrates that identity in projectified work is dynamic, relational, and continuously reconstructed through mechanisms such as narrative construction, reflexivity, role negotiation, boundary management, and social recognition. Simultaneously, projectification generates structural pressures—including identity fragmentation, role ambiguity, temporal compression, and power asymmetries—that may undermine well-being and long-term professional development. Identity is thus conceptualized as a critical mediating mechanism through which projectified structures shape individual experiences and sustainability outcomes. By positioning identity as the central analytical link between agency, power, and sustainability, the paper advances projectification research beyond predominantly managerial and structural accounts. It further outlines avenues for longitudinal, cross-cultural, and intervention-based research and highlights practical implications for designing identity-supportive project practices, including structured reflection, recognition systems, and mechanisms that promote career continuity across projects.

AI.tldr: 本文通过整合文献综述，探讨了项目化工作中个体如何构建、维持和协商身份认同，提出了连接身份工作机制、结构挑战、能动性、福祉和人类可持续性的分析框架。
AI.research_question: 在日益项目化的工作形式中，个体如何构建、维持和协商身份认同？项目化结构如何通过身份认同机制影响个体体验和可持续性结果？
AI.motivation: 项目化已通过临时性、目标导向的项目广泛改变了组织、公共和公民领域，但其对人类和身份认同相关的影响尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合项目管理、组织研究和身份认同理论，构建连接身份工作机制、结构挑战、能动性、福祉和人类可持续性的分析框架。
AI.method: 采用概念性和整合性文献综述方法，综合项目管理、组织研究和身份认同理论的相关研究。
AI.findings: 项目化工作中的身份认同是动态的、关系性的，通过叙事构建、反思性、角色协商、边界管理和社会认可等机制不断重构。同时，项目化产生身份碎片化、角色模糊、时间压缩和权力不对称等结构压力，可能损害福祉和长期职业发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 将身份认同定位为连接能动性、权力和可持续性的核心分析环节，推动项目化研究超越主要的管理和结构视角。概念化身份认同作为项目化结构塑造个体体验和可持续性结果的关键中介机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计支持身份认同的项目实践提供启示，包括结构化反思、认可系统以及促进跨项目职业连续性的机制。为纵向研究、跨文化研究和干预性研究指明方向。

detail.title: Exploring CEOs’ Global Mindset Attributes

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not pertain to human subjects research and did not require IRB approval.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Thunderbird International Business Review, 0[10.1002/tie.70080]

detail.abstract: Despite numerous studies on Chief Executive Officers (CEOs) and the global mindset construct, research on the global mindset of CEOs remains limited. This knowledge gap remains especially problematic in the increasingly global business landscape of the 21st century. In this landscape, two phenomena co-exist: the rise of foreign-born CEOs successfully leading multinationals, and the under-representation of female leaders at the CEO level. Therefore, this paper aims to explore CEOs’ global mindset attributes and differences across male/female CEOs, with qualitative studies focusing on 25 CEOs of different ethnicities across various industries, using document analysis of 2,339 pages from 250 documents (2001–2024) with a priori coding based on published global mindset variables, followed by in vivo coding. The findings indicate that psychological dimension attributes - dealing with challenges, taking risks, and testing personal abilities - are predominant. Thematic analysis supports the Upper Echelons Theory (UET), with CEOs' behavioral attributes and experiences shaping how they lead. In the technology industry, Indian-origin CEOs excel at risk-taking, while CEOs of other ethnicities exhibit high self-confidence. In other industries, the social dimension is also predominant among CEOs. CEO gender differences were notable: female Indian-origin CEOs in technology are more risk-taking than their male counterparts, while female CEOs of other ethnicities are more risk-averse. By extending the UET with a focus on CEOs’ global mindset, this research aims to contribute to international human resource management and global leadership literature. Our findings have multiple implications for investors, board members, and CEO candidates in today's global business context.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨CEO全球思维属性及其性别差异，通过分析25位不同族裔CEO的文档资料，发现心理维度属性（应对挑战、承担风险、测试个人能力）占主导地位，支持高阶理论，并揭示了技术行业和其他行业中不同族裔CEO的全球思维差异以及显著的性别差异。
AI.research_question: CEO的全球思维属性是什么？这些属性在男性和女性CEO之间存在哪些差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管有大量关于CEO和全球思维的研究，但对CEO全球思维的研究仍然有限。在21世纪日益全球化的商业环境中，两个现象并存：外籍CEO成功领导跨国公司的兴起，以及女性领导者在CEO层面的代表性不足。这一知识缺口在当前的全球商业环境中尤其成问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高阶理论（Upper Echelons Theory, UET）——CEO的行为属性和经验塑造了他们的领导方式
AI.method: 定性研究，聚焦25位不同族裔、不同行业的CEO，使用文档分析法分析2001-2024年间的250份文档（共2,339页），采用基于已发表全球思维变量的先验编码，随后进行实地编码
AI.findings: 1. 心理维度属性（应对挑战、承担风险、测试个人能力）占主导地位；2. 主题分析支持高阶理论；3. 在技术行业，印度裔CEO擅长风险承担，而其他族裔CEO表现出高度自信；4. 在其他行业，社会维度在CEO中也占主导地位；5. CEO性别差异显著：技术行业的印度裔女性CEO比男性同行更愿意承担风险，而其他族裔的女性CEO则更规避风险
AI.theory_contributions: 通过聚焦CEO的全球思维扩展了高阶理论，为国际人力资源管理和全球领导力文献做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 研究发现对投资者、董事会成员和CEO候选人在当今全球商业环境中具有多重启示，有助于更好地理解和选拔具有全球思维的领导者

publicationDetails.detailsText: Data Science in Finance and Accounting. Studies in Big Data, vol 181. Springer, Cham. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-06179-9_11

detail.abstract: The primary objective of the research is to offer investors and readers a comprehensive guide in selecting a portfolio that maximizes profits and minimizes risks during the investment process. The portfolio is a collection of various investments held by an investor, including stocks, bonds, securities, real estate, fund certificates, bank deposits, gold, foreign currency, and other investment products. The design of a portfolio depends on an investor’s risk appetite and financial goals. However, the research focuses mainly on stock portfolios. The study utilizes multiple methods to analyze data to assess risk. It is essential to consider various statistical measures, including matrix functions, variance, standard deviation, and variation coefficient. Additionally, an empirical study is conducted using the return on equity (ROEA) dataset collected from three large companies listed in Ho Chi Minh City stock exchange over the time series from 2005 to 2023. This study provides a practical understanding of how investors and readers can apply the methods used to measure risk in real investment situations. The research offers guidance to investors and readers on how to choose portfolio optimization that ensures the appropriate allocation of investments, achieves the desired level of profitability, and minimizes risks. To build a portfolio, investors should focus on three key components: investment types, allocation ratios, and risk tolerance. By considering these factors, they can align portfolios with their investment goals. The chapter discusses four basic portfolio types: risky, safe, income-providing, and balanced, detailing their advantages and disadvantages. This information helps investors make informed decisions when selecting a portfolio that suits their goals and risk appetite.

detail.abstract: Traditional automotive showrooms have long served as the primary interface between vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. However, these physical retail spaces are increasingly constrained by high operating costs, limited display capacity, geographic dependency, and inefficiencies in addressing modern consumer expectations. Recent advancements in digital technologies particularly Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) have enabled the emergence of automotive virtual showrooms, redefining how vehicles are marketed, experienced, and sold. This paper examines the evolution of the showroom concept from a physical marketing location to a digitally mediated, immersive retail environment. Drawing on existing showroom theory and recent industry evidence, the study analyses the technological foundations, economic implications, consumer behaviour impacts, and strategic consequences of virtual automotive showrooms.

detail.abstract: Margin control has become one of the most critical yet complex challenges in contemporary business management, particularly for organizations operating across multiple industries. Traditional management structures often address finance, sales, and logistics as separate functional domains, resulting in fragmented decision-making and unintended margin erosion. This study argues that sustainable margin performance cannot be achieved through isolated optimization efforts but requires an integrated executive management approach.

contentFormat.other: This is a first version of a Standard for Judgement Architecture

detail.abstract:
Judgement Architecture is a formal operating discipline for making human Judgement explicit, assigned, and enforceable at the points in AI-enabled workflows where decisions become consequential. This standard defines when and how that discipline must be applied.

As AI and automated systems accelerate organisational decision-making, a structural condition known as Responsibility Erosion emerges: the gradual loss of clear accountability as automation advances faster than the structures for human Judgement can keep up. This standard exists to prevent that condition by making Judgement visible before action is taken.

The standard defines the conditions that require human Judgement, the mechanisms for enforcing it through Judgement gates and workflow controls, and the failure modes that arise when it is absent. It specifies four Mandatory Judgement Stops, the points at which informal discretion must cease and explicit human accountability must be established before work proceeds.

The standard is tool-agnostic, industry-agnostic, and role-agnostic. It applies wherever AI or automation accelerates work faster than Judgement can be clarified.

This standard is a companion to the Judgement Architecture Canonical Glossary, which defines the full vocabulary of Judgement Architecture. The two documents are designed to be used together.

The standard introduced here is offered as a contribution to a field that urgently needs operational structure, one rigorous enough to govern AI systems and practical enough to apply at the moment a consequential decision is made.

AI.motivation: 随着AI和自动化系统加速组织决策，出现了"责任侵蚀"的结构性条件：自动化发展速度快于人类判断结构跟进速度，导致清晰问责制的逐渐丧失。该标准旨在通过在执行前使判断可见来防止这种情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 判断架构理论、责任侵蚀理论、组织决策理论、AI治理框架、工作流程控制理论。
AI.method: 标准制定方法、操作规范设计、判断门和工作流程控制机制设计、四个强制性判断停止点的定义。

AI.theory_contributions: 1. 正式定义了"判断架构"作为AI治理的操作规范；2. 提出了"责任侵蚀"的理论概念；3. 建立了判断门和工作流程控制的理论框架；4. 定义了四个强制性判断停止点的理论模型。

contentFormat.other: This is a Canonical Glossary for the Judgement Architecture Standard which is also being submitted

detail.abstract:
Judgement Architecture is a formal operating discipline for making human Judgement explicit, assigned, and enforceable at the points in AI-enabled workflows where decisions become consequential. This glossary establishes its canonical vocabulary.

The terms defined here are the working language of Judgement Architecture in practice. They cover the conditions that require human Judgement, the mechanisms for enforcing it, the failure modes that arise when it is absent, and the organisational-level condition, Responsibility Erosion, that results when automation outpaces accountability.

Every entry includes a Test: a single diagnostic question a practitioner can apply in real time to determine whether the concept is in play.

This glossary is a companion to the Judgement Architecture Standard, which defines the requirements for implementing Judgement Architecture in AI-enabled work. The two documents are designed to be used together.

The vocabulary introduced here is offered as a contribution to a field that urgently needs shared language, one precise enough to govern AI systems and plain enough to use in the room where decisions actually happen.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了"判断架构"这一正式操作规范，用于在AI赋能工作流程中使人类判断变得明确、可分配和可执行，并建立了其标准词汇表。

AI.method: 建立标准词汇表方法，每个条目包含测试问题，供从业者实时诊断概念是否适用。作为判断架构标准的配套文件，两者设计为配合使用。
AI.findings: 建立了判断架构的规范词汇表，涵盖了需要人类判断的条件、执行机制、失败模式和组织层面的责任侵蚀状况，为实践提供了可操作的语言工具。

title: Distributed Organization – Enhanced Approach
affiliations: Wrocław University of Science and Technology and

detail.title: Distributed Organization – Enhanced Approach
detail.abstract: This article develops an enhanced conceptualization of the distributed organization as a structural and cognitive response to the conditions of uncertainty and ambiguity characteristic of contemporary VUCA and BANI environments. Moving beyond the dominant understanding of distributed organizations as primarily geographically dispersed entities, the study defines distributed organization as a multi-nodal system composed of a lean hierarchical core and dynamically interpenetrating knowledge nodes connected through diverse internal and external relationships. Drawing on literature on organizational structures, complexity, sensemaking, and dynamic capabilities, the paper identifies ambiguity-rather than dynamism alone-as the key determinant of contemporary organizational functioning. In response, it introduces ambiguity management capabilities as a metacompetence enabling organizations to interpret weak and conflicting signals, sustain multiple interpretations, and act under conditions of incomplete knowledge. The enhanced distributed organization is presented as an architectural form that enables such capabilities through distributed sensemaking, decentralized decisionmaking, cognitive diversity, and dynamic balance between order and flexibility. The article contributes to management and quality sciences by redefining the concept of organizational distribution, proposing its multidimensional concept, and identifying structural, human, cultural, and technological enablers necessary for the functioning of distributed organizations. The proposed framework offers both theoretical clarification and practical guidance for designing organizations capable of maintaining coherence and effectiveness in environments characterized by radical uncertainty and interpretive indeterminacy.

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义了分布式组织概念，将其视为应对VUCA和BANI环境中不确定性和模糊性的结构认知响应系统，提出模糊性管理能力作为元能力，并构建了分布式组织架构框架。
AI.research_question: 在当代VUCA和BANI环境的不确定性和模糊性条件下，如何重新概念化分布式组织，使其能够有效管理模糊性并维持组织效能？
AI.motivation: 传统对分布式组织的理解主要局限于地理分散性，无法充分应对当代环境中日益增加的模糊性和不确定性，需要更全面的概念框架来指导组织设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织结构理论、复杂性理论、意义建构理论、动态能力理论，特别强调模糊性而非单纯动态性作为组织功能的关键决定因素。
AI.method: 概念性理论研究，通过文献综述和理论整合构建新的概念框架。
AI.findings: 分布式组织应被重新定义为由精简层级核心和动态互渗知识节点组成的多节点系统；模糊性管理能力是关键的元能力；分布式组织通过分布式意义建构、分散决策、认知多样性和秩序与灵活性之间的动态平衡来实现这些能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义组织分布概念，提出多维度的分布式组织概念框架，识别结构、人力、文化和技术等使能因素，为管理科学和质量科学提供理论澄清。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计能够在根本不确定性和解释不确定性环境中保持连贯性和有效性的组织提供实践指导框架。

title: High-Cost Medicines and Rare Diseases in the Sus: How the Risk-Sharing Agreement Can Reduce the Judicialization of Health
affiliations: and Faculdade de Direito de Franca

detail.title: High-Cost Medicines and Rare Diseases in the Sus: How the Risk-Sharing Agreement Can Reduce the Judicialization of Health

publicationDetails.detailsText: XXXII CONGRESSO NACIONAL DO  CONPEDI SÃO PAULO - SP - DIREITO E SAÚDE I, p. 121-138, 978-65-5274-3, https://site.conpedi.org.br/publicacoes/6h25op4f/23lu1cdr/Z1KbhwEEqjRj7gSR.pdf; https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18363958

detail.abstract: The incorporation of innovative and high-cost medicines into the Unified Health System (SUS), especially for rare diseases, poses significant economic and structural challenges, aggravated by the growth of the judicialization of health. In this scenario, the Risk-Sharing Agreement (RSA)-in Portuguese, Acordo de Partilha de Risco (APR)-emerges as a strategic alternative by conditioning payment for medicines on proof of their effectiveness in clinical practice. This approach enables risk sharing between the State and the pharmaceutical industry, contributing to budgetary sustainability and efficiency in resource allocation. The RSA model can also reduce judicialization by offering more rational, evidence-based solutions, ensuring effective access to treatments and avoiding court decisions that compromise the equity of the SUS. International experience shows that RSAs improve decision-making in public health and can be adapted to the Brazilian context as a mechanism to balance innovation, access, and fiscal responsibility. It is concluded that adopting APR/RSA represents a promising institutional innovation, capable of strengthening public management and expanding access to effective medicines without compromising the foundations of a universal health system.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了风险共担协议（RSA/APR）作为巴西统一卫生系统（SUS）应对高成本创新药物（特别是罕见病药物）的战略替代方案，通过将药品支付与临床实践有效性证明挂钩，实现国家与制药行业风险共担，促进预算可持续性和资源分配效率。
AI.research_question: 风险共担协议（RSA/APR）如何作为巴西统一卫生系统（SUS）应对高成本创新药物（特别是罕见病药物）的战略替代方案，平衡创新、可及性和财政责任？
AI.motivation: 将创新和高成本药物纳入统一卫生系统（SUS）面临重大经济和结构挑战，特别是罕见病药物，加之卫生司法化日益增长，需要寻找既能确保患者获得有效治疗，又能维持系统可持续性的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险共担协议（RSA）理论框架，包括基于价值的定价、结果导向的支付模式、风险分配理论、卫生经济学中的预算影响分析，以及公共管理中的制度创新理论。
AI.method: 基于国际经验的政策分析，结合巴西统一卫生系统（SUS）的具体情境，进行制度设计和适应性分析，探讨RSA/APR在巴西的实施路径和潜在影响。
AI.findings: RSA/APR能够通过将药品支付与临床有效性证明挂钩，实现国家与制药行业风险共担；该模式有助于减少卫生司法化，提供更理性、循证的解决方案；国际经验表明RSA能改善公共卫生决策，可适应巴西情境平衡创新、可及性和财政责任。
AI.theory_contributions: 为风险共担协议在发展中国家卫生系统中的应用提供理论框架；扩展了基于价值的定价和结果导向支付模式在公共卫生系统中的理论应用；丰富了卫生系统可持续性与创新药物可及性平衡的理论探讨。
